  // ============================================================
  // ✅ LOCAL SLUG HELPER — used as last-resort safety net
  // Guarantees a non-empty ASCII slug for the backend
  // ============================================================
  static String _safeSlug(String input) {
    if (input.trim().isEmpty) return 'document';

    final lower = input.toLowerCase().trim();

    final hindiMap = <String, String>{
      'आधार कार्ड': 'aadhaar_card',
      'आधार': 'aadhaar_card',
      'मूल निवास प्रमाण पत्र': 'domicile_certificate',
      'मूल निवास': 'domicile_certificate',
      'निवास प्रमाण पत्र': 'residence_certificate',
      'निवास': 'residence_certificate',
      'आय प्रमाण पत्र': 'income_certificate',
      'आय': 'income_certificate',
      'बैंक पासबुक': 'bank_passbook',
      'बैंक': 'bank_passbook',
      'राशन कार्ड': 'ration_card',
      'राशन': 'ration_card',
      'जन्म प्रमाण पत्र': 'birth_certificate',
      'जन्म': 'birth_certificate',
      'जाति प्रमाण पत्र': 'caste_certificate',
      'जाति': 'caste_certificate',
      'पासपोर्ट': 'passport',
      'फोटो': 'photo',
      'हस्ताक्षर': 'signature',
      'अन्य': 'other',
      'दस्तावेज': 'document',
      'दस्तावेज़': 'document',
      'प्रमाण पत्र': 'certificate',
    };

    if (hindiMap.containsKey(input.trim())) return hindiMap[input.trim()]!;

    final sortedKeys = hindiMap.keys.toList()
      ..sort((a, b) => b.length.compareTo(a.length));
    for (final key in sortedKeys) {
      if (lower.contains(key.toLowerCase())) return hindiMap[key]!;
    }

    String slug = input
        .toLowerCase()
        .trim()
        .replaceAll(RegExp(r'[^a-z0-9]+'), '_')
        .replaceAll(RegExp(r'_+'), '_')
        .replaceAll(RegExp(r'^_|_$'), '');

    if (slug.isEmpty) return 'document';
    if (slug.length > 60) {
      slug = slug.substring(0, 60).replaceAll(RegExp(r'_$'), '');
    }
    return slug;
  }

  // ============================================================
  // ✅ LIST SCHEMES
  // ============================================================
  static Future<Map<String, dynamic>> listSchemes({
    String? level,
    String? state,
    String? category,
    String? search,
    bool? isFeatured,
    int limit = 100,
    int skip = 0,
  }) async {
    try {
      final params = <String, dynamic>{
        'limit': limit,
        'skip': skip,
      };
      if (level != null && level != 'all') params['level'] = level;
      if (state != null && state != 'all') params['state'] = state;
      if (category != null && category != 'all') params['category'] = category;
      if (search != null && search.isNotEmpty) params['search'] = search;
      if (isFeatured != null) params['is_featured'] = isFeatured;

      debugPrint("📤 SchemeService.listSchemes params: $params");

      final res = await _dio.get('$_base/list', queryParameters: params);
      final data = _unwrap(res.data);

      final schemes = data['schemes'] as List? ?? [];

      if (schemes.isNotEmpty) {
        debugPrint("✅ Loaded ${schemes.length} schemes from BACKEND");
        return {
          'success': true,
          'schemes': schemes,
          'total': data['total'] ?? schemes.length,
          'source': 'backend',
        };
      }

      debugPrint("⚠️ Backend returned 0 schemes → using LOCAL master data");
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint("❌ Backend failed: $e → using LOCAL master data");
    }

    return _getLocalSchemes(
      level: level,
      state: state,
      category: category,
      search: search,
      isFeatured: isFeatured,
      limit: limit,
    );
  }

  // ============================================================
  // ✅ LOCAL FALLBACK
  // ============================================================
  static Map<String, dynamic> _getLocalSchemes({
    String? level,
    String? state,
    String? category,
    String? search,
    bool? isFeatured,
    int limit = 100,
  }) {
    List<GovernmentScheme> schemes = SchemesMasterData.allSchemes;

    if (level != null && level != 'all') {
      schemes = schemes.where((s) => s.level == level).toList();
    }
    if (state != null && state != 'all') {
      schemes = schemes.where((s) => s.state == state).toList();
    }
    if (category != null && category != 'all') {
      schemes = schemes.where((s) => s.category == category).toList();
    }
    if (isFeatured == true) {
      schemes = schemes.where((s) => s.isFeatured).toList();
    }
    if (search != null && search.isNotEmpty) {
      final q = search.toLowerCase();
      schemes = schemes
          .where((s) =>
              s.schemeName.toLowerCase().contains(q) ||
              s.schemeNameHindi.contains(q) ||
              s.shortDescription.toLowerCase().contains(q) ||
              s.shortDescriptionHindi.contains(q) ||
              s.tags.any((t) => t.toLowerCase().contains(q)))
          .toList();
    }

    schemes = schemes.take(limit).toList();
    final schemesJson = schemes.map((s) => _schemeToJson(s)).toList();

    debugPrint("✅ Loaded ${schemesJson.length} schemes from LOCAL master data");

    return {
      'success': true,
      'schemes': schemesJson,
      'total': schemesJson.length,
      'source': 'local',
    };
  }

  }

  // ============================================================
  // ✅✅✅ CRITICAL FIX: APPLY FOR SCHEME
  // ============================================================
  static Future<Map<String, dynamic>> applyForScheme({
    required String schemeId,
    required Map<String, dynamic> applicantDetails,
    required Map<String, dynamic> applicantAddress,
    required Map<String, dynamic> bankDetails,
    String? remarks,
    List<Map<String, dynamic>>? documents,
  }) async {
    try {
      final List<Map<String, dynamic>> normalizedDocuments = [];

      if (documents != null && documents.isNotEmpty) {
        for (int i = 0; i < documents.length; i++) {
          final doc = documents[i];

          final String url = (doc['url'] ??
                  doc['document_url'] ??
                  doc['documentUrl'] ??
                  doc['file_url'] ??
                  doc['fileUrl'] ??
                  '')
              .toString()
              .trim();

          if (url.isEmpty) {
            debugPrint(
                "⚠️ Skipping document[$i] — no URL found. Keys: ${doc.keys.toList()}");
            continue;
          }

          final String docName = (doc['document_name'] ??
                  doc['label'] ??
                  doc['name'] ??
                  'Document ${i + 1}')
              .toString()
              .trim();

          final String rawType =
              (doc['document_type'] ?? doc['type'] ?? '').toString().trim();

          final String docType =
              rawType.isEmpty ? _safeSlug(docName) : rawType;

          final publicId = doc['public_id'] ?? doc['publicId'];

          final normalized = <String, dynamic>{
            'document_type': docType,
            'document_name': docName,
            'url': url,
            'document_url': url,
            'public_id': publicId,
            'uploaded_at':
                doc['uploaded_at'] ?? DateTime.now().toIso8601String(),
          };

          normalizedDocuments.add(normalized);

          debugPrint("📎 Doc[$i] prepared → "
              "type=$docType, name=$docName, url=${url.substring(0, url.length > 80 ? 80 : url.length)}...");
        }
      }

      final Map<String, dynamic> payload = {
        'scheme_id': schemeId,
        'applicant_details': applicantDetails,
        'applicant_address': applicantAddress,
        'bank_details': bankDetails,
        'remarks': remarks ?? '',
        'application_type': 'schemes',  // ✅ CRITICAL
        'payment_type': 'scheme',        // ✅ CRITICAL
        'category_used': 'scheme',       // ✅ CRITICAL
      };

      if (normalizedDocuments.isNotEmpty) {
        payload['documents'] = normalizedDocuments;
      }

      debugPrint("=" * 70);
      debugPrint("📤 applyForScheme CALLED");
      debugPrint("   Scheme ID: $schemeId");
      debugPrint("   Payload keys: ${payload.keys.toList()}");
      debugPrint("   Documents count: ${normalizedDocuments.length}");
      for (int i = 0; i < normalizedDocuments.length; i++) {
        debugPrint(
            "   [$i] ${normalizedDocuments[i]['document_type']} → ${normalizedDocuments[i]['url']}");
      }
      debugPrint("=" * 70);

      final res = await _dio.post('$_base/apply', data: payload);

      debugPrint("📥 applyForScheme response: ${res.statusCode}");
      debugPrint("   ${res.data}");

      return _unwrap(res.data);
    } on DioException catch (e) {
      debugPrint("❌ applyForScheme failed: ${e.response?.data}");
      throw DioClient.extractErrorMessage(e);
    }
  }

  // ============================================================
  // ✅✅✅ CRITICAL FIX: UPLOAD TEMP DOCUMENT
  // ============================================================
  static Future<Map<String, dynamic>> uploadTempDocument({
    required Uint8List fileBytes,
    required String fileName,
    required String documentType,
    required String documentName,
  }) async {
    try {
      String safeDocType = documentType.trim();
      if (safeDocType.isEmpty) {
        safeDocType =
            _safeSlug(documentName.isNotEmpty ? documentName : fileName);
        debugPrint("🔧 documentType was empty → derived: '$safeDocType'");
      }
      if (safeDocType.isEmpty) {
        safeDocType = 'document';
      }

      String safeDocName = documentName.trim();
      if (safeDocName.isEmpty) safeDocName = fileName;

      debugPrint("=" * 70);
      debugPrint("📤 uploadTempDocument CALLED");
      debugPrint("   fileName: $fileName");
      debugPrint("   documentType: $safeDocType");
      debugPrint("   documentName: $safeDocName");
      debugPrint("   fileBytes: ${fileBytes.length} bytes");
      debugPrint("=" * 70);

      final formData = FormData.fromMap({
        'file': MultipartFile.fromBytes(fileBytes, filename: fileName),
        'document_type': safeDocType,
        'document_name': safeDocName,
      });

      final res =
          await _dio.post('$_base/upload-temp-document', data: formData);

      debugPrint("📥 uploadTempDocument raw response: ${res.statusCode}");
      debugPrint("   ${res.data}");

      String? url;
      String? publicId;
      String? finalDocType;
      String? finalDocName;

      final rawData = res.data;

      if (rawData is Map) {
        if (rawData['url'] != null) {
          url = rawData['url'].toString();
        }
        if ((url == null || url.isEmpty) && rawData['document_url'] != null) {
          url = rawData['document_url'].toString();
        }
        if ((url == null || url.isEmpty) && rawData['document'] is Map) {
          final nested = rawData['document'] as Map;
          url = (nested['url'] ?? nested['document_url'])?.toString();
          publicId = (nested['public_id'] ?? nested['publicId'])?.toString();
          finalDocType = nested['document_type']?.toString();
          finalDocName = nested['document_name']?.toString();
        }
        if ((url == null || url.isEmpty) && rawData['data'] is Map) {
          final nested = rawData['data'] as Map;
          url = (nested['url'] ?? nested['document_url'])?.toString();
          if ((url == null || url.isEmpty) && nested['document'] is Map) {
            final deeper = nested['document'] as Map;
            url = (deeper['url'] ?? deeper['document_url'])?.toString();
            publicId ??=
                (deeper['public_id'] ?? deeper['publicId'])?.toString();
            finalDocType ??= deeper['document_type']?.toString();
            finalDocName ??= deeper['document_name']?.toString();
          }
        }
        if (publicId == null) {
          publicId = (rawData['public_id'] ?? rawData['publicId'])?.toString();
        }
      }

      if (url == null || url.isEmpty) {
        debugPrint("❌ No URL found in uploadTempDocument response!");
        debugPrint("   Response was: $rawData");
        throw Exception("Upload succeeded but no URL returned from server");
      }

      debugPrint("=" * 70);
      debugPrint("✅ uploadTempDocument SUCCESS");
      debugPrint("   URL: $url");
      debugPrint("   publicId: $publicId");
      debugPrint("=" * 70);

      return {
        'success': true,
        'url': url,
        'document_url': url,
        'public_id': publicId,
        'document_type': finalDocType ?? safeDocType,
        'document_name': finalDocName ?? safeDocName,
        'filename': fileName,
      };
    } on DioException catch (e) {
      debugPrint("❌ uploadTempDocument failed: ${e.response?.data}");
      throw DioClient.extractErrorMessage(e);
    }
  }

  // ============================================================
  // ✅ APPLY WITH FILES (multipart)
  // ============================================================
  static Future<Map<String, dynamic>> applyForSchemeWithFiles({
    required String schemeId,
    required Map<String, dynamic> applicantDetails,
    required Map<String, dynamic> applicantAddress,
    required Map<String, dynamic> bankDetails,
    String? remarks,
    required List<Map<String, dynamic>> files,
  }) async {
    try {
      debugPrint("=" * 70);
      debugPrint("📤 applyForSchemeWithFiles CALLED");
      debugPrint("   Scheme ID: $schemeId");
      debugPrint("   Files count: ${files.length}");
      for (final f in files) {
        final bytes = f['bytes'] as Uint8List?;
        debugPrint("   • ${f['document_name']} → "
            "${bytes?.length ?? 0} bytes, type=${f['document_type']}");
      }
      debugPrint("=" * 70);

      final Map<String, dynamic> payload = {
        'scheme_id': schemeId,
        'applicant_details': applicantDetails,
        'applicant_address': applicantAddress,
        'bank_details': bankDetails,
        'remarks': remarks ?? '',
        'application_type': 'schemes',  // ✅ CRITICAL
        'payment_type': 'scheme',        // ✅ CRITICAL
        'category_used': 'scheme',       // ✅ CRITICAL
      };

      final formMap = <String, dynamic>{
        'payload': jsonEncode(payload),
      };

      final List<MultipartFile> multipartFiles = [];
      final List<String> docTypes = [];
      final List<String> docNames = [];

      for (final f in files) {
        final bytes = f['bytes'] as Uint8List?;
        if (bytes == null || bytes.isEmpty) continue;

        final fileName = (f['file_name'] ?? 'document.pdf').toString();
        final rawType = (f['document_type'] ?? '').toString();
        final docName = (f['document_name'] ?? 'Document').toString();

        final docType = rawType.isEmpty ? _safeSlug(docName) : rawType;

        multipartFiles.add(
          MultipartFile.fromBytes(bytes, filename: fileName),
        );
        docTypes.add(docType);
        docNames.add(docName);
      }

      if (multipartFiles.isEmpty) {
        throw Exception("No valid files to upload");
      }

      formMap['files'] = multipartFiles;
      formMap['document_types'] = jsonEncode(docTypes);
      formMap['document_names'] = jsonEncode(docNames);

      final formData = FormData.fromMap(formMap);

      debugPrint("📦 FormData prepared:");
      debugPrint("   Files: ${multipartFiles.length}");
      debugPrint("   Types: $docTypes");
      debugPrint("   Names: $docNames");

      final res = await _dio.post(
        '$_base/apply-with-files',
        data: formData,
        options: Options(
          headers: {"Content-Type": "multipart/form-data"},
          sendTimeout: const Duration(minutes: 5),
          receiveTimeout: const Duration(minutes: 5),
        ),
      );

      debugPrint("📥 applyWithFiles response: ${res.statusCode} | ${res.data}");
      return _unwrap(res.data);
    } on DioException catch (e) {
      debugPrint("❌ applyWithFiles failed: ${e.response?.data}");
      throw DioClient.extractErrorMessage(e);
    }
  }

  // ============================================================
  // ✅ UPLOAD SCHEME DOCUMENT (single file, per application)
  // ============================================================
  static Future<Map<String, dynamic>> uploadSchemeDocument({
    required String applicationId,
    required String documentType,
    required String documentName,
    required Uint8List fileBytes,
    required String fileName,
  }) async {
    try {
      String safeDocType = documentType.trim();
      if (safeDocType.isEmpty) {
        safeDocType =
            _safeSlug(documentName.isNotEmpty ? documentName : fileName);
      }
      if (safeDocType.isEmpty) safeDocType = 'document';

      debugPrint("=" * 70);
      debugPrint("📤 UPLOADING SCHEME DOCUMENT");
      debugPrint("   Application ID: $applicationId");
      debugPrint("   Document Type: $safeDocType");
      debugPrint("   Document Name: $documentName");
      debugPrint("   File Name: $fileName");
      debugPrint("   File Size: ${fileBytes.length} bytes");
      debugPrint(
          "   Endpoint: $_base/application/$applicationId/upload-document");
      debugPrint("=" * 70);

      final formData = FormData.fromMap({
        'file': MultipartFile.fromBytes(
          fileBytes,
          filename: fileName,

        'document_type': safeDocType,
        'document_name': documentName,
      });

      final res = await _dio.post(
        '$_base/application/$applicationId/upload-document',
        data: formData,
        options: Options(
          headers: {"Content-Type": "multipart/form-data"},
        ),
      );

      debugPrint("📥 Upload response: ${res.statusCode} | ${res.data}");
      return _unwrap(res.data);
    } on DioException catch (e) {
      debugPrint("❌ Upload failed: ${e.response?.data}");
      throw DioClient.extractErrorMessage(e);
    }
  }

  // ============================================================
  // ✅ MY APPLICATIONS
  // ============================================================
  static Future<Map<String, dynamic>> getMyApplications(
      {String? status}) async {
    try {
      final params = <String, dynamic>{};
      if (status != null && status != 'all') params['status'] = status;
      final res = await _dio.get(
        '$_base/my-applications',
        queryParameters: params.isEmpty ? null : params,
      );
      return _unwrap(res.data);
    } on DioException catch (e) {
      throw DioClient.extractErrorMessage(e);
    }
  }

  // ============================================================
  // ✅ GET APPLICATION DETAIL (user-scoped)
  // ============================================================
  static Future<Map<String, dynamic>> getApplicationDetail(
      String applicationId) async {
    try {
      final res = await _dio.get('$_base/application/$applicationId');
      return _unwrap(res.data);
    } on DioException catch (e) {
      throw DioClient.extractErrorMessage(e);
    }
  }

  // ============================================================
  // ✅✅✅ CRITICAL FIX: GET DOCUMENTS FOR AN APPLICATION
  // ------------------------------------------------------------
  // FIX: Now uses FLEXIBLE ID resolution — works with BOTH:
  //      - MongoDB _id (e.g. "6ad180c78f1a1108853039e3")
  //      - application_id (e.g. "20261000020")
  //
  // The backend `/documents` endpoint now accepts both.
  // ============================================================
  static Future<Map<String, dynamic>> getApplicationDocuments(
      String applicationId) async {
    try {
      debugPrint("=" * 70);
      debugPrint("📄 getApplicationDocuments CALLED");
      debugPrint("   applicationId: '$applicationId'");
      debugPrint("   URL: $_base/application/$applicationId/documents");
      debugPrint("=" * 70);

      final res = await _dio.get(
        '$_base/application/$applicationId/documents',
      );

      debugPrint("📥 Response status: ${res.statusCode}");
      debugPrint("📥 Response data type: ${res.data.runtimeType}");

      final body = res.data;

      if (body is Map) {
        final schemeDocs = _extractDocList(body['scheme_documents']);
        final adminDocs = _extractDocList(body['admin_documents']);

        debugPrint("✅ scheme_documents: ${schemeDocs.length}");
        debugPrint("✅ admin_documents: ${adminDocs.length}");

        return {
          'success': body['success'] == true,
          'scheme_documents': schemeDocs,
          'admin_documents': adminDocs,
          'total': body['total'] ??
              (schemeDocs.length + adminDocs.length),
          'application_id': body['application_id'],
          'application_number': body['application_number'],
        };
      }

      return {
        'success': false,
        'scheme_documents': <Map<String, dynamic>>[],
        'admin_documents': <Map<String, dynamic>>[],
        'total': 0,
      };
    } on DioException catch (e) {
      debugPrint("❌ getApplicationDocuments error:");
      debugPrint("   Status: ${e.response?.statusCode}");
      debugPrint("   Message: ${e.message}");
      debugPrint("   Data: ${e.response?.data}");

      return {
        'success': false,
        'scheme_documents': <Map<String, dynamic>>[],
        'admin_documents': <Map<String, dynamic>>[],
        'total': 0,
        'error': DioClient.extractErrorMessage(e),
      };
    }
  }

  // ============================================================
  // ✅ HELPER: Extract document list from any structure
  // ============================================================
  static List<Map<String, dynamic>> _extractDocList(dynamic raw) {
    if (raw is! List) return <Map<String, dynamic>>[];

    final result = <Map<String, dynamic>>[];
    for (final item in raw) {
      if (item is! Map) continue;

      final doc = Map<String, dynamic>.from(item);

      // Validate URL
      final url = (doc['url'] ?? doc['document_url'] ?? '').toString().trim();
      if (url.isEmpty) continue;
      if (url.toLowerCase() == 'null' ||
          url.toLowerCase() == 'undefined' ||
          url.toLowerCase() == 'n/a') {
        continue;
      }

      result.add(doc);
    }
    return result;
  }

  // ============================================================
  // ✅ DELETE DOCUMENT (per application)
  // ============================================================
  static Future<bool> deleteApplicationDocument({
    required String applicationId,
    required String documentType,
  }) async {
    try {
      final res = await _dio.delete(
        '$_base/application/$applicationId/document/$documentType',
      );
      final body = res.data;
      if (body is Map && body['success'] == true) {
        return true;
      }
      return false;
    } on DioException catch (e) {
      debugPrint(
          "❌ deleteApplicationDocument error: ${DioClient.extractErrorMessage(e)}");
      return false;
    }
  }

  // ============================================================
  // ✅ SUBMIT APPLICATION (FINAL USER-SIDE SUBMIT)
  // ============================================================
  static Future<Map<String, dynamic>> submitApplication({
    required String applicationId,
    Map<String, dynamic>? data,
  }) async {
    try {

        '$_base/application/$applicationId/submit',
        data: data ?? {},
      );
      return _unwrap(res.data);
    } on DioException catch (e) {
      throw DioClient.extractErrorMessage(e);
    }
  }

  // ============================================================

  static Future<Map<String, dynamic>> getCustomAdminSchemeApplications({

    try {
      final Map<String, dynamic> params = {
        'application_type': 'schemes',

      debugPrint("=" * 70);

        '/customadmin/applications',

      debugPrint("📥 Response type: ${res.data.runtimeType}");

      Map<String, dynamic> data = {};
      if (res.data is Map<String, dynamic>) {
        final raw = res.data as Map<String, dynamic>;
        if (raw.containsKey('data') && raw['data'] is Map) {
          data = Map<String, dynamic>.from(raw['data'] as Map);
        } else {
          data = raw;

      }

      final apps = data['applications'];

      return data;
    } on DioException catch (e) {

  }

      debugPrint("✅ Review document uploaded: ${res.statusCode}");
      return _unwrap(res.data);

// lib/features/schemes/presentation/screens/customadmin_scheme_applications_screen.dart
// ============================================================
// CUSTOM ADMIN SCHEME APPLICATIONS SCREEN
// ============================================================
// ✅ Displays all scheme applications submitted by users
// ✅ Admin can view, approve, reject, and manage scheme applications
// ✅ Uses the same UI pattern as Job/Service applications
// ✅ Full detail view with documents, status updates
// ✅ Works in both embedded and full-screen modes
// ============================================================
// ✅ FIXED: Added missing imports (dart:typed_data, dart:io)
// ✅ FIXED: Documents now properly fetched from backend
// ✅ FIXED: User documents and Admin documents now show separately
// ✅ FIXED: Review and Final Submit buttons now work EXACTLY like
//           Service Application Screen and Job Application Screen
// ✅ FIXED: Document upload now works on BOTH Web and Mobile
// ✅ FIXED: File is now MANDATORY before submit
// ✅ FIXED: Status update now correctly changes to review/final_submit
// ✅ FIXED: Action buttons now shown for ALL non-final statuses
// ✅ FIXED: Quick Actions now show ONLY Review and Final Submit buttons
//           (matching Service Application Screen layout exactly)
// ✅ FIXED (NEW): After Review/Final Submit, the UI updates INSTANTLY
//           with the new status and new admin document, WITHOUT waiting
//           for any network refresh or page reload.
// ✅ FIXED (NEW): _selectedApplication and _applications are patched
//           locally with the server's response before any re-fetch.
// ✅ FIXED (NEW): New admin document is prepended to _adminDocuments
//           immediately so the "Admin Uploaded Documents" card shows it.
// ✅ FIXED (NEW): Universal ID matcher handles _id / application_id /
//           application_number so patching never misses.
// ============================================================

class CustomAdminSchemeApplicationsScreen extends StatefulWidget {

      _CustomAdminSchemeApplicationsScreenState();
}

class _CustomAdminSchemeApplicationsScreenState
    extends State<CustomAdminSchemeApplicationsScreen>
    with SingleTickerProviderStateMixin {
  // ==================== STATE ====================
  List<Map<String, dynamic>> _applications = [];
  List<Map<String, dynamic>> _filteredApplications = [];
  bool _isLoading = true;
  bool _isRefreshing = false;
  bool _isUpdatingStatus = false;
  String? _errorMessage;
  String _selectedFilter = 'all';

  // ==================== SELECTED APPLICATION FOR DETAIL VIEW ====================
  Map<String, dynamic>? _selectedApplication;

  // ✅ TWO SEPARATE DOCUMENT LISTS (like jobs/services)
  List<Map<String, dynamic>> _userDocuments = [];
  List<Map<String, dynamic>> _adminDocuments = [];
  bool _isLoadingDocuments = false;

  late AnimationController _pulseController;
  late Animation<double> _pulseAnimation;

  // ============================================================
  // FILTER BUTTONS
  // ============================================================
  final List<Map<String, dynamic>> _filterButtons = [
    {
      'value': 'all',
      'label': 'All',
      'icon': Icons.list,
      'color': Colors.grey,
    },
    {
      'value': 'pending',
      'label': 'Pending',
      'icon': Icons.hourglass_empty,
      'color': Colors.orange,
    },
    {
      'value': 'under_review',
      'label': 'Review',
      'icon': Icons.rate_review,
      'color': Colors.blue,
    },
    {
      'value': 'approved',
      'label': 'Approved',
      'icon': Icons.verified,
      'color': Colors.teal,
    },
    {
      'value': 'rejected',
      'label': 'Rejected',
      'icon': Icons.cancel,
      'color': Colors.red,
    },
    {
      'value': 'completed',
      'label': 'Completed',
      'icon': Icons.celebration,
      'color': Colors.green,
    },
  ];

  // ============================================================
  // LIFECYCLE
  // ============================================================
  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _pulseController = AnimationController(
      duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 1500),
      vsync: this,
    )..repeat(reverse: true);
    _pulseAnimation = Tween<double>(begin: 0.9, end: 1.1).animate(
      CurvedAnimation(parent: _pulseController, curve: Curves.easeInOut),
    );
    _loadApplications();
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _pulseController.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  // ============================================================
  // LOAD APPLICATIONS
  // ============================================================
  Future<void> _loadApplications() async {
    if (!mounted) return;
    setState(() {
      _isLoading = true;
      _errorMessage = null;
    });

    try {
      debugPrint("=" * 70);
      debugPrint("📤 LOADING SCHEME APPLICATIONS (CustomAdmin)");
      debugPrint("   URL: /customadmin/applications");
      debugPrint("   Query: application_type=schemes");
      debugPrint("=" * 70);

      final response = await DioClient.dio.get(
        '/customadmin/applications',
        queryParameters: {
          'application_type': 'schemes',
        },
      );

      if (!mounted) return;

      debugPrint("📥 Response status: ${response.statusCode}");
      debugPrint("📥 Response data type: ${response.data.runtimeType}");

      List<dynamic> apps = [];

      if (response.data is Map) {
        final data = response.data as Map;
        if (data.containsKey('applications') && data['applications'] is List) {
          apps = data['applications'] as List<dynamic>;
        } else if (data.containsKey('data')) {
          final inner = data['data'];
          if (inner is List) {
            apps = inner;
          } else if (inner is Map &&
              inner.containsKey('applications') &&
              inner['applications'] is List) {
            apps = inner['applications'] as List<dynamic>;
          }
        }
      } else if (response.data is List) {
        apps = response.data as List;
      }

      debugPrint("✅ Loaded ${apps.length} scheme applications");

      final enrichedApps = apps.map((app) {
        final appMap = app is Map<String, dynamic>
            ? app
            : Map<String, dynamic>.from(app as Map);
        return _enrichApplication(appMap);
      }).toList();

      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(() {
        _applications = enrichedApps;
        _isLoading = false;
        _isRefreshing = false;
        _errorMessage = null;
      });
      _applyFilter();
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint("❌ Failed to load scheme applications: $e");
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() {
          _isLoading = false;
          _isRefreshing = false;
          _errorMessage = e.toString();
          _applications = [];
          _filteredApplications = [];
        });
      }
    }
  }

  // ============================================================
  // ENRICH APPLICATION WITH DISPLAY DATA
  // ============================================================
  Map<String, dynamic> _enrichApplication(Map<String, dynamic> app) {
    final schemeName = app['scheme_name']?.toString() ?? 'Government Scheme';
    final schemeNameHindi =
        app['scheme_name_hindi']?.toString().isNotEmpty == true
            ? app['scheme_name_hindi'].toString()
            : schemeName;
    final schemeLevel = app['scheme_level']?.toString() ?? 'central';
    final schemeState = app['scheme_state']?.toString();
    final schemeCategory = app['scheme_category']?.toString() ?? 'other';

    final applicationNumber =
        app['application_number']?.toString().isNotEmpty == true
            ? app['application_number'].toString()
            : (app['application_id']?.toString().isNotEmpty == true
                ? app['application_id'].toString()
                : (app['_id']?.toString() ?? ''));

    final applicantDetails = app['applicant_details'] is Map
        ? Map<String, dynamic>.from(app['applicant_details'] as Map)
        : <String, dynamic>{};
    final applicantName = app['user_name']?.toString().isNotEmpty == true
        ? app['user_name'].toString()
        : (applicantDetails['full_name']?.toString() ?? 'Unknown');
    final applicantEmail = app['user_email']?.toString() ?? 'N/A';
    final applicantMobile = app['user_mobile']?.toString() ??
        (applicantDetails['mobile']?.toString() ?? '');

    String icon = '📋';
    switch (schemeCategory.toLowerCase()) {
      case 'agriculture':
        icon = '🌾';
        break;
      case 'health':
        icon = '🏥';
        break;
      case 'housing':
        icon = '🏠';
        break;
      case 'education':
        icon = '📚';
        break;
      case 'employment':
        icon = '💼';
        break;
      case 'women_child':
        icon = '👩';
        break;
      case 'pension':
        icon = '👴';
        break;
      case 'insurance':
        icon = '🛡️';
        break;
      case 'entrepreneurship':
        icon = '🚀';
        break;
      case 'financial_inclusion':
        icon = '💰';
        break;
      default:
        icon = '📋';
    }

    return {
      ...app,
      'application_id': applicationNumber,
      'application_number': applicationNumber,
      'applicant_name': applicantName,
      'applicant_email': applicantEmail,
      'applicant_mobile': applicantMobile,
      'display_scheme_name': schemeName,
      'display_scheme_name_hindi': schemeNameHindi,
      'display_scheme_icon': icon,
      'display_scheme_level': schemeLevel == 'central' ? 'Central' : 'State',
      'display_scheme_state': schemeState,
      'display_scheme_category': schemeCategory,
    };
  }

  // ============================================================
  // APPLY FILTER
  // ============================================================
  void _applyFilter() {
    List<Map<String, dynamic>> result;

    if (_selectedFilter == 'all') {
      result = List.from(_applications);
    } else {
      result = _applications.where((app) {
        final status = (app['status'] ?? '').toString().toLowerCase();
        final filterLower = _selectedFilter.toLowerCase();

        if (filterLower == 'under_review') {
          return status == 'under_review' ||
              status == 'review_application' ||
              status == 'pending_verification';
        }
        if (filterLower == 'approved') {
          return status == 'approved' ||
              status == 'approved_application' ||
              status == 'verification_successful' ||
              status == 'payment_verified';
        }
        if (filterLower == 'pending') {
          return status == 'pending' ||
              status == 'payment_pending' ||
              status == 'submitted';
        }
        if (filterLower == 'completed') {
          return status == 'completed' ||
              status == 'final_submitted';
        }
        return status == filterLower;
      }).toList();
    }

    if (mounted) {
      setState(() {
        _filteredApplications = result;
      });
    }
  }

  void _onFilterSelected(String value) {
    if (_selectedFilter == value) return;
    setState(() => _selectedFilter = value);
    _applyFilter();
  }

  // ============================================================
  // REFRESH
  // ============================================================
  Future<void> _refresh() async {
    if (_isRefreshing) return;
    setState(() => _isRefreshing = true);
    await _loadApplications();
  }

  // ============================================================
  // STRICT URL VALIDATOR
  // ============================================================
  bool _isValidDocUrl(dynamic value) {
    if (value == null) return false;
    if (value is Map && value.isEmpty) return false;
    if (value is List && value.isEmpty) return false;

    final str = value.toString().trim();
    if (str.isEmpty) return false;

    final lower = str.toLowerCase();
    if (lower == 'null' ||
        lower == 'undefined' ||
        lower == 'n/a' ||
        lower == 'na' ||
        lower == '-' ||
        lower == 'none' ||
        lower == 'false' ||
        lower == 'true' ||
        lower == '0' ||
        lower == '{}' ||
        lower == '[]') {
      return false;
    }

    if (!str.startsWith('http://') &&
        !str.startsWith('https://') &&
        !str.startsWith('file:') &&
        !str.startsWith('blob:')) {
      return false;
    }

    if (str.length < 12) return false;
    return true;
  }

  // ============================================================
  // ✅ UNIVERSAL ID MATCHER
  // ------------------------------------------------------------
  // Matches an application against ANY of its identifier fields:
  //   - _id          (MongoDB ObjectId string)
  //   - application_id  (normalized application number)
  //   - application_number (same value as application_id)
  // ------------------------------------------------------------
  bool _matchesApplicationId(Map<String, dynamic> app, String id) {
    if (id.isEmpty) return false;
    return app['application_id']?.toString() == id ||
        app['_id']?.toString() == id ||
        app['application_number']?.toString() == id;
  }

  // ============================================================
  // ✅ FETCH APPLICATION DOCUMENTS - CRITICAL FIX
  // ------------------------------------------------------------
  // ✅ Uses the CORRECT endpoint: /schemes/application/{id}/documents
  // ✅ This endpoint returns BOTH scheme_documents[] AND admin_documents[]
  // ✅ Falls back to the detail endpoint only if /documents fails
  // ============================================================
  Future<void> _fetchApplicationDocuments(String applicationId) async {
    if (!mounted || applicationId.isEmpty) return;

    setState(() {
      _isLoadingDocuments = true;
      _userDocuments = [];
      _adminDocuments = [];
    });

    final List<Map<String, dynamic>> userDocs = [];
    final List<Map<String, dynamic>> adminDocs = [];

    try {
      debugPrint("=" * 70);
      debugPrint("📄 FETCHING SCHEME APPLICATION DOCUMENTS");
      debugPrint("   Application ID: $applicationId");
      debugPrint("   Endpoint: /schemes/application/$applicationId/documents");
      debugPrint("=" * 70);

      // ============================================================
      // ✅ STEP 1: PRIMARY — Use the dedicated /documents endpoint
      // ============================================================
      try {
        final docsResponse = await DioClient.dio.get(
          '/schemes/application/$applicationId/documents',
        );

        if (mounted) {
          debugPrint("📥 /documents status: ${docsResponse.statusCode}");
          debugPrint("📥 /documents data: ${docsResponse.data}");

          if (docsResponse.data is Map) {
            final body = Map<String, dynamic>.from(docsResponse.data as Map);

            final rawUserDocs = body['scheme_documents'];
            final rawAdminDocs = body['admin_documents'];

            // ---------- USER DOCS ----------
            if (rawUserDocs is List) {
              debugPrint("📄 scheme_documents: ${rawUserDocs.length}");
              for (final raw in rawUserDocs) {
                if (raw is! Map) continue;
                final doc = Map<String, dynamic>.from(raw);

                final url =
                    (doc['url'] ?? doc['document_url'] ?? '').toString().trim();
                if (!_isValidDocUrl(url)) {
                  debugPrint("⏭️ Skipping user doc (invalid URL): $url");
                  continue;
                }

                userDocs.add({
                  'key': (doc['document_type'] ?? 'document').toString(),
                  'label': (doc['document_name'] ??
                          doc['label'] ??
                          doc['document_type'] ??
                          'Document')
                      .toString(),
                  'url': url,
                  'download_url': (doc['download_url'] ?? url).toString(),
                  'source': (doc['source'] ?? 'schemes_application').toString(),
                  'is_application_doc': true,
                  'is_admin_doc': false,
                  'is_user_doc': true,
                  'uploaded_at': doc['uploaded_at'],
                });
              }
            }

            // ---------- ADMIN DOCS ----------
            if (rawAdminDocs is List) {
              debugPrint("📄 admin_documents: ${rawAdminDocs.length}");
              for (final raw in rawAdminDocs) {
                if (raw is! Map) continue;
                final doc = Map<String, dynamic>.from(raw);

                final url =
                    (doc['url'] ?? doc['document_url'] ?? '').toString().trim();
                if (!_isValidDocUrl(url)) {
                  debugPrint("⏭️ Skipping admin doc (invalid URL): $url");
                  continue;
                }

                final source = (doc['source'] ?? 'admin_review').toString();
                final badge = (doc['badge'] ??
                        (source == 'admin_final'
                            ? 'ADMIN FINAL'
                            : 'ADMIN REVIEW'))
                    .toString();

                adminDocs.add({
                  'key': (doc['document_type'] ?? 'admin_doc').toString(),
                  'label': (doc['document_name'] ??
                          doc['label'] ??
                          doc['document_type'] ??
                          'Admin Document')
                      .toString(),
                  'url': url,
                  'download_url': (doc['download_url'] ?? url).toString(),
                  'source': source,
                  'is_application_doc': true,
                  'is_admin_doc': true,
                  'badge': badge,
                  'badgeColor': source == 'admin_final'
                      ? Colors.deepPurple
                      : Colors.orange,
                  'uploaded_at': doc['uploaded_at'],
                });
              }
            }

            debugPrint("✅ From /documents → "
                "userDocs=${userDocs.length}, adminDocs=${adminDocs.length}");
          }
        }
      } catch (primaryError) {
        debugPrint("⚠️ /documents endpoint failed: $primaryError");
        debugPrint("   Falling back to detail endpoint...");
      }

      // ============================================================
      // ✅ STEP 2: FALLBACK — Use /application/{id} detail endpoint
      // ============================================================
      if (userDocs.isEmpty && adminDocs.isEmpty) {
        debugPrint("=" * 70);
        debugPrint("📄 FALLBACK: Using /schemes/application/$applicationId");
        debugPrint("=" * 70);

        try {
          final response = await DioClient.dio.get(
            '/schemes/application/$applicationId',
          );

          if (mounted) {
            debugPrint("📥 Detail status: ${response.statusCode}");

            Map<String, dynamic> appData = {};
            if (response.data is Map) {
              final data = response.data as Map;

              if (data.containsKey('application') &&
                  data['application'] is Map) {
                appData =
                    Map<String, dynamic>.from(data['application'] as Map);
              } else if (data.containsKey('data') && data['data'] is Map) {
                final innerData = data['data'] as Map;
                if (innerData.containsKey('application') &&
                    innerData['application'] is Map) {
                  appData = Map<String, dynamic>.from(
                      innerData['application'] as Map);
                } else {
                  appData = Map<String, dynamic>.from(innerData);
                }
              } else {
                appData = Map<String, dynamic>.from(data);
              }
            }

            debugPrint("📄 Detail appData keys: ${appData.keys.toList()}");

            // ---------- A. scheme_documents[] (NEW format) ----------
            final schemeDocsArray = appData['scheme_documents'];
            if (schemeDocsArray is List) {
              debugPrint("📄 scheme_documents[]: ${schemeDocsArray.length}");
              for (final raw in schemeDocsArray) {
                if (raw is! Map) continue;
                final doc = Map<String, dynamic>.from(raw);
                final url = (doc['url'] ?? doc['document_url'] ?? '')
                    .toString()
                    .trim();
                if (!_isValidDocUrl(url)) continue;

                userDocs.add({
                  'key': (doc['document_type'] ?? 'document').toString(),
                  'label': (doc['document_name'] ??
                          doc['label'] ??
                          doc['document_type'] ??
                          'Document')
                      .toString(),
                  'url': url,
                  'download_url': (doc['download_url'] ?? url).toString(),
                  'source': (doc['source'] ?? 'schemes_application').toString(),
                  'is_application_doc': true,
                  'is_admin_doc': false,
                  'is_user_doc': true,
                  'uploaded_at': doc['uploaded_at'],
                });
              }
            }

            // ---------- B. documents[] (LEGACY format) ----------
            final documentsArray = appData['documents'];
            if (documentsArray is List) {
              debugPrint("📄 documents[] (legacy): ${documentsArray.length}");
              for (final raw in documentsArray) {
                if (raw is! Map) continue;
                final doc = Map<String, dynamic>.from(raw);

                final url =
                    (doc['url'] ?? doc['document_url'] ?? '').toString().trim();
                if (!_isValidDocUrl(url)) {
                  debugPrint("⏭️ Skipping legacy doc (invalid URL): $url");
                  continue;
                }

                if (userDocs.any((d) => d['url'] == url)) {
                  debugPrint("⏭️ Skipping duplicate legacy doc: $url");
                  continue;
                }

                userDocs.add({
                  'key': (doc['document_type'] ?? 'document').toString(),
                  'label': (doc['document_name'] ??
                          doc['label'] ??
                          doc['document_type'] ??
                          'Document')
                      .toString(),
                  'url': url,
                  'download_url': (doc['download_url'] ?? url).toString(),
                  'source': 'schemes_application',
                  'is_application_doc': true,
                  'is_admin_doc': false,
                  'is_user_doc': true,
                  'uploaded_at': doc['uploaded_at'],
                });
              }
            }

            // ---------- C. submitted_document_url (Admin Review) ----------
            final submittedUrl = appData['submitted_document_url'];
            if (_isValidDocUrl(submittedUrl)) {
              final urlStr = submittedUrl.toString().trim();
              if (!adminDocs.any((d) => d['url'] == urlStr)) {
                adminDocs.add({
                  'key': 'submitted_document_url',
                  'label': appData['submitted_document_name']?.toString() ??
                      'Review Document (Admin)',
                  'url': urlStr,
                  'download_url':
                      appData['submitted_document_download_url'] ?? urlStr,
                  'source': 'admin_review',
                  'is_application_doc': true,
                  'is_admin_doc': true,
                  'badge': 'ADMIN REVIEW',
                  'badgeColor': Colors.orange,
                  'uploaded_at': appData['submitted_at'],
                });
              }
            }

            // ---------- D. final_document_url (Admin Final) ----------
            final finalUrl = appData['final_document_url'];
            if (_isValidDocUrl(finalUrl)) {
              final urlStr = finalUrl.toString().trim();
              if (!adminDocs.any((d) => d['url'] == urlStr)) {
                adminDocs.add({
                  'key': 'final_document_url',
                  'label': appData['final_document_name']?.toString() ??
                      'Final Submission Document (Admin)',
                  'url': urlStr,
                  'download_url':
                      appData['final_document_download_url'] ?? urlStr,
                  'source': 'admin_final',
                  'is_application_doc': true,
                  'is_admin_doc': true,
                  'badge': 'ADMIN FINAL',
                  'badgeColor': Colors.deepPurple,
                  'uploaded_at': appData['final_submitted_at'],
                });
              }
            }
          }
        } catch (fallbackError) {
          debugPrint("⚠️ Fallback detail endpoint also failed: $fallbackError");
        }
      }

      debugPrint("=" * 70);
      debugPrint("✅ FINAL TOTALS:");
      debugPrint("   USER documents: ${userDocs.length}");
      debugPrint("   ADMIN documents: ${adminDocs.length}");
      debugPrint("=" * 70);
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint("❌ FATAL: _fetchApplicationDocuments error: $e");
      debugPrint("   Stack: ${StackTrace.current}");
    } finally {
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() {
          _userDocuments = userDocs;
          _adminDocuments = adminDocs;
          _isLoadingDocuments = false;
        });
      }
    }
  }

  // ============================================================
  // VIEW APPLICATION DETAILS
  // ============================================================
  void _showApplicationDetails(Map<String, dynamic> app) {
    final applicationId = app['application_id']?.toString() ?? '';

    setState(() {
      _selectedApplication = app;
      _userDocuments = [];
      _adminDocuments = [];
    });

    if (applicationId.isNotEmpty) {
      _fetchApplicationDocuments(applicationId);
    }
  }

  void _closeDetails() {
    setState(() {
      _selectedApplication = null;
      _userDocuments = [];
      _adminDocuments = [];
    });
    _refresh();
  }

  // ============================================================
  // ✅ REFRESH APPLICATION DETAIL — BULLETPROOF VERSION
  // ------------------------------------------------------------
  // ✅ FIRST: extract the fresh application map
  // ✅ THEN:  patch _selectedApplication and _applications locally
  // ✅ THEN:  re-fetch documents so new admin docs appear
  // ✅ The UI is already correct BEFORE the document refetch
  // ============================================================
  Future<void> _refreshApplicationDetail(String applicationId) async {
    if (!mounted || applicationId.isEmpty) return;

    debugPrint("=" * 70);
    debugPrint("🔄 REFRESHING APPLICATION DETAIL");
    debugPrint("   Application ID: $applicationId");
    debugPrint("=" * 70);

    try {
      final response = await DioClient.dio.get(
        '/schemes/application/$applicationId',
      );

      if (!mounted) return;

      // ---------- Extract the raw application map ----------
      Map<String, dynamic> updatedApp = {};
      if (response.data is Map) {
        final data = response.data as Map;

        if (data.containsKey('application') && data['application'] is Map) {
          updatedApp = Map<String, dynamic>.from(data['application'] as Map);
        } else if (data.containsKey('data') && data['data'] is Map) {
          final innerData = data['data'] as Map;
          if (innerData.containsKey('application') &&
              innerData['application'] is Map) {
            updatedApp =
                Map<String, dynamic>.from(innerData['application'] as Map);
          } else {
            updatedApp = Map<String, dynamic>.from(innerData);
          }
        } else {
          updatedApp = Map<String, dynamic>.from(data);
        }
      }

      if (updatedApp.isEmpty) {
        debugPrint("⚠️ Empty updated app from server");
        // Still re-fetch documents so admin docs show up
        await _fetchApplicationDocuments(applicationId);
        return;
      }

      // ---------- Preserve display fields ----------
      final oldApp = _selectedApplication ?? {};
      final enrichedApp = _enrichApplication({
        ...oldApp,
        ...updatedApp,
      });

      debugPrint("✅ New status from server: ${enrichedApp['status']}");

      if (!mounted) return;

      // ============================================================
      // ✅ CRITICAL: Update local state IMMEDIATELY
      // ============================================================
      setState(() {
        // 1. Update in the main list
        final index = _applications.indexWhere(
          (app) => _matchesApplicationId(app, applicationId),
        );
        if (index != -1) {
          _applications[index] = enrichedApp;
        }

        // 2. Update the selected application — THIS is what the
        //    detail view reads on rebuild
        if (_selectedApplication != null) {
          _selectedApplication = enrichedApp;
        }

        // 3. Reset documents so loading spinner shows
        _userDocuments = [];
        _adminDocuments = [];
        _isLoadingDocuments = true;
      });

      // 4. Re-apply filter so list view is in sync
      _applyFilter();

      // 5. Re-fetch documents (new admin doc will now appear)
      await _fetchApplicationDocuments(applicationId);

      debugPrint("✅ Application detail refreshed successfully");
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint("❌ Failed to refresh application detail: $e");
    }
  }

  // ============================================================
  // UPDATE APPLICATION STATUS (Approve / Reject)
  // ============================================================
  Future<void> _updateStatus(String applicationId, String newStatus) async {
    if (!mounted || _isUpdatingStatus) return;
    setState(() => _isUpdatingStatus = true);

    try {
      debugPrint("📤 Updating application $applicationId to status: $newStatus");

      final response = await DioClient.dio.put(
        '/schemes/application/$applicationId/status',
        data: {
          'status': newStatus,
          'admin_notes': 'Status updated by custom admin',
        },
      );

      if (!mounted) return;

      if (response.data['success'] == true) {
        // ✅ Patch local state immediately
        if (_selectedApplication != null) {
          final patched = Map<String, dynamic>.from(_selectedApplication!)
            ..['status'] = newStatus
            ..['admin_notes'] = 'Status updated by custom admin'
            ..['updated_at'] = DateTime.now().toIso8601String();

          setState(() {
            _selectedApplication = patched;
            final index = _applications.indexWhere(
              (a) => _matchesApplicationId(a, applicationId),
            );
            if (index != -1) {
              _applications[index] = patched;
            }
          });
          _applyFilter();
        }

        showMessage(context, "✅ Status updated to ${newStatus.toUpperCase()}");
        _refreshApplicationDetail(applicationId);
      } else {
        showMessage(
          context,
          response.data['message'] ?? "Failed to update status",
          isError: true,
        );
      }
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint("❌ Failed to update status: $e");
      if (mounted) {
        showMessage(context, "Failed to update status: $e", isError: true);
      }
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _isUpdatingStatus = false);
    }
  }

  // ============================================================
  // ✅ REVIEW WITH DOCUMENT — INSTANT UI UPDATE
  // ------------------------------------------------------------
  // After successful upload, we FIRST patch _selectedApplication
  // locally with status = 'review_application' and the new doc URL,
  // THEN trigger the server refresh in the background.
  // ============================================================
  Future<void> _showReviewDialog(String applicationId) async {
    debugPrint("=" * 70);
    debugPrint("📝 OPENING SCHEME REVIEW DIALOG");
    debugPrint("   Application ID: $applicationId");
    debugPrint("   Platform: ${kIsWeb ? 'WEB' : 'MOBILE'}");
    debugPrint("=" * 70);

    final TextEditingController notesController = TextEditingController();

    final result = await showDialog<Map<String, dynamic>?>(
      context: context,
      barrierDismissible: false,
      builder: (dialogContext) => _ReviewDialogContent(
        notesController: notesController,
      ),
    );

    if (result == null) {
      debugPrint("❌ Review dialog cancelled");
      return;
    }

    debugPrint("=" * 70);
    debugPrint("✅ REVIEW DIALOG RETURNED");
    debugPrint("   Has File: ${result['hasFile']}");
    debugPrint("   File Name: ${result['fileName']}");
    debugPrint("   Notes: ${result['notes']}");
    debugPrint("=" * 70);

    final bool hasFile = result['hasFile'] == true;
    final Uint8List? fileBytes = result['fileBytes'] as Uint8List?;
    final String? fileName = result['fileName'] as String?;
    final String notes = (result['notes'] ?? '').toString().trim();

    if (!hasFile || fileBytes == null || fileBytes.isEmpty || fileName == null) {
      showMessage(context, "⚠️ Please select a document for review",
          isError: true);
      return;
    }

    setState(() => _isUpdatingStatus = true);

    try {
      debugPrint("📤 Uploading review document...");
      debugPrint("   File: $fileName");
      debugPrint("   Size: ${fileBytes.length} bytes");

      final formData = FormData.fromMap({
        'file': MultipartFile.fromBytes(fileBytes, filename: fileName),
        'notes': notes,
      });

      final uploadResponse = await DioClient.dio.post(
        '/schemes/application/$applicationId/review-with-document',
        data: formData,
        options: Options(headers: {"Content-Type": "multipart/form-data"}),
      );

      if (!mounted) return;

      debugPrint("📥 Upload response: ${uploadResponse.statusCode}");
      debugPrint("📥 Upload response data: ${uploadResponse.data}");

      final body = uploadResponse.data is Map
          ? Map<String, dynamic>.from(uploadResponse.data as Map)
          : <String, dynamic>{};

      if (body['success'] == true) {
        // ============================================================
        // ✅ INSTANT LOCAL UPDATE — no network wait needed
        // ============================================================
        final newStatus = body['status']?.toString().isNotEmpty == true
            ? body['status'].toString()
            : 'review_application';

        final newDocUrl =
            body['submitted_document_url']?.toString().isNotEmpty == true
                ? body['submitted_document_url'].toString()
                : '';
        final newDocName =
            body['submitted_document_name']?.toString().isNotEmpty == true
                ? body['submitted_document_name'].toString()
                : fileName;

        if (_selectedApplication != null) {
          final patched = Map<String, dynamic>.from(_selectedApplication!)
            ..['status'] = newStatus
            ..['submitted_document_url'] = newDocUrl
            ..['submitted_document_name'] = newDocName
            ..['submitted_at'] = DateTime.now().toIso8601String()
            ..['admin_notes'] =
                notes.isNotEmpty ? notes : 'Review document uploaded'
            ..['updated_at'] = DateTime.now().toIso8601String();

          setState(() {
            _selectedApplication = patched;

            // Also patch main list
            final index = _applications.indexWhere(
              (a) => _matchesApplicationId(a, applicationId),
            );
            if (index != -1) {
              _applications[index] = patched;
            }

            // ✅ Add the new admin doc immediately so it shows
            // without waiting for the document refetch
            if (newDocUrl.isNotEmpty &&
                !_adminDocuments.any((d) => d['url'] == newDocUrl)) {
              _adminDocuments = [
                {
                  'key': 'submitted_document_url',
                  'label': newDocName,
                  'url': newDocUrl,
                  'download_url':
                      body['submitted_document_download_url']?.toString() ??
                          newDocUrl,
                  'source': 'admin_review',
                  'is_admin_doc': true,
                  'badge': 'ADMIN REVIEW',
                  'badgeColor': Colors.orange,
                  'uploaded_at': DateTime.now().toIso8601String(),
                },
                ..._adminDocuments,
              ];
            }
          });

          _applyFilter();

          showMessage(
            context,
            "✅ Document uploaded. Status: UNDER REVIEW",
          );

          debugPrint("✅ Local UI patched — status = $newStatus");

          // Optional: re-fetch fresh data from server (non-blocking)
          _refreshApplicationDetail(applicationId);
        } else {
          // No selected app — just refresh list
          showMessage(context, "✅ Document uploaded & moved to REVIEW!");
          await _refreshApplicationDetail(applicationId);
        }
      } else {
        showMessage(
          context,
          body['message']?.toString() ?? "Failed to upload document",
          isError: true,
        );
      }
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint("❌ Error in review submit: $e");
      if (mounted) {
        showMessage(context, "Failed: $e", isError: true);
      }
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _isUpdatingStatus = false);
    }
  }

  // ============================================================
  // ✅ FINAL SUBMIT WITH DOCUMENT — INSTANT UI UPDATE
  // ------------------------------------------------------------
  // After successful upload, we FIRST patch _selectedApplication
  // locally with status = 'final_submitted' and the new doc URL,
  // THEN trigger the server refresh in the background.
  // ============================================================
  Future<void> _showFinalSubmitDialog(String applicationId) async {
    debugPrint("=" * 70);
    debugPrint("📝 OPENING SCHEME FINAL SUBMIT DIALOG");
    debugPrint("   Application ID: $applicationId");
    debugPrint("   Platform: ${kIsWeb ? 'WEB' : 'MOBILE'}");
    debugPrint("=" * 70);

    final TextEditingController notesController = TextEditingController();

    final result = await showDialog<Map<String, dynamic>?>(
      context: context,
      barrierDismissible: false,
      builder: (dialogContext) => _FinalSubmitDialogContent(
        notesController: notesController,
      ),
    );

    if (result == null) {
      debugPrint("❌ Final submit dialog cancelled");
      return;
    }

    debugPrint("=" * 70);
    debugPrint("✅ FINAL SUBMIT DIALOG RETURNED");
    debugPrint("   Has File: ${result['hasFile']}");
    debugPrint("   File Name: ${result['fileName']}");
    debugPrint("   Notes: ${result['notes']}");
    debugPrint("=" * 70);

    final bool hasFile = result['hasFile'] == true;
    final Uint8List? fileBytes = result['fileBytes'] as Uint8List?;
    final String? fileName = result['fileName'] as String?;
    final String notes = (result['notes'] ?? '').toString().trim();

    if (!hasFile || fileBytes == null || fileBytes.isEmpty || fileName == null) {
      showMessage(context, "⚠️ Please select a document for final submission",
          isError: true);
      return;
    }

    setState(() => _isUpdatingStatus = true);

    try {
      debugPrint("📤 Uploading final document...");
      debugPrint("   File: $fileName");
      debugPrint("   Size: ${fileBytes.length} bytes");

      final formData = FormData.fromMap({
        'file': MultipartFile.fromBytes(fileBytes, filename: fileName),
        'notes': notes,
      });

      final uploadResponse = await DioClient.dio.post(
        '/schemes/application/$applicationId/final-submit-with-document',
        data: formData,
        options: Options(headers: {"Content-Type": "multipart/form-data"}),
      );

      if (!mounted) return;

      debugPrint("📥 Upload response: ${uploadResponse.statusCode}");
      debugPrint("📥 Upload response data: ${uploadResponse.data}");

      final body = uploadResponse.data is Map
          ? Map<String, dynamic>.from(uploadResponse.data as Map)
          : <String, dynamic>{};

      if (body['success'] == true) {
        // ============================================================
        // ✅ INSTANT LOCAL UPDATE
        // ============================================================
        final newStatus = body['status']?.toString().isNotEmpty == true
            ? body['status'].toString()
            : 'final_submitted';

        final newDocUrl = body['final_document_url']?.toString().isNotEmpty ==
                true
            ? body['final_document_url'].toString()
            : (body['submitted_document_url']?.toString().isNotEmpty == true
                ? body['submitted_document_url'].toString()
                : '');

        final newDocName = body['document_name']?.toString().isNotEmpty == true
            ? body['document_name'].toString()
            : (body['submitted_document_name']?.toString().isNotEmpty == true
                ? body['submitted_document_name'].toString()
                : fileName);

        if (_selectedApplication != null) {
          final patched = Map<String, dynamic>.from(_selectedApplication!)
            ..['status'] = newStatus
            ..['final_document_url'] = newDocUrl
            ..['submitted_document_url'] = newDocUrl
            ..['submitted_document_name'] = newDocName
            ..['final_submitted_at'] = DateTime.now().toIso8601String()
            ..['admin_notes'] = notes.isNotEmpty ? notes : 'Final submission'
            ..['updated_at'] = DateTime.now().toIso8601String();

          setState(() {
            _selectedApplication = patched;

            final index = _applications.indexWhere(
              (a) => _matchesApplicationId(a, applicationId),
            );
            if (index != -1) {
              _applications[index] = patched;
            }

            // ✅ Add the new admin final doc immediately
            if (newDocUrl.isNotEmpty &&
                !_adminDocuments.any((d) => d['url'] == newDocUrl)) {
              _adminDocuments = [
                {
                  'key': 'final_document_url',
                  'label': newDocName,
                  'url': newDocUrl,
                  'download_url':
                      body['final_document_download_url']?.toString() ??
                          newDocUrl,
                  'source': 'admin_final',
                  'is_admin_doc': true,
                  'badge': 'ADMIN FINAL',
                  'badgeColor': Colors.deepPurple,
                  'uploaded_at': DateTime.now().toIso8601String(),
                },
                ..._adminDocuments,
              ];
            }
          });

          _applyFilter();

          showMessage(
            context,
            "✅ FINAL SUBMISSION completed!",
          );

          debugPrint("✅ Local UI patched — status = $newStatus");

          // Optional: re-fetch fresh data from server (non-blocking)
          _refreshApplicationDetail(applicationId);
        } else {
          showMessage(context, "✅ FINAL SUBMISSION completed!");
          await _refreshApplicationDetail(applicationId);
        }
      } else {
        showMessage(
          context,
          body['message']?.toString() ?? "Failed to upload final document",
          isError: true,
        );
      }
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint("❌ Error in final submit: $e");
      if (mounted) {
        showMessage(context, "Failed: $e", isError: true);
      }
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _isUpdatingStatus = false);
    }
  }

  // ============================================================
  // DOCUMENT VIEWER
  // ============================================================
  Future<void> _openDocumentViewer(
    String url, {
    String title = 'Document',
    String? downloadUrl,
    String? fileType,
  }) async {
    if (url.isEmpty) {
      showMessage(context, "Document URL not available", isError: true);
      return;
    }

    String finalUrl = url.trim();
    if (!finalUrl.startsWith('http') &&
        !finalUrl.startsWith('file') &&
        !finalUrl.startsWith('blob:')) {
      finalUrl = 'https://$finalUrl';
    }

    showDialog(
      context: context,
      barrierDismissible: false,
      builder: (dialogContext) => Dialog(
        insetPadding: EdgeInsets.zero,
        child: Container(
          width: MediaQuery.of(dialogContext).size.width * 0.95,
          height: MediaQuery.of(dialogContext).size.height * 0.9,
          decoration: BoxDecoration(
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
            color: Colors.white,
          ),
          child: FileViewerScreen(
            url: finalUrl,
            title: title,
            downloadUrl: downloadUrl ?? finalUrl,
            fileType: fileType,
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  // ============================================================
  // HELPER METHODS
  // ============================================================
  Color _getStatusColor(String status) {
    switch (status.toLowerCase()) {
      case 'approved':
      case 'approved_application':
      case 'verification_successful':
      case 'payment_verified':
      case 'completed':
      case 'final_submitted':
        return const Color(0xFF10B981);
      case 'rejected':
      case 'verification_rejected':
      case 'update_rejected':
        return const Color(0xFFEF4444);
      case 'under_review':
      case 'review_application':
      case 'pending_verification':
        return const Color(0xFF3B82F6);
      case 'update_application':
        return const Color(0xFF8B5CF6);
      case 'pending':
      case 'payment_pending':
      case 'submitted':
      default:
        return const Color(0xFFF59E0B);
    }
  }

  String _getStatusDisplay(String status) {
    switch (status.toLowerCase()) {
      case 'approved':
      case 'approved_application':
        return 'APPROVED';
      case 'verification_successful':
      case 'payment_verified':
        return 'VERIFIED';
      case 'completed':
      case 'final_submitted':
        return 'COMPLETED';
      case 'rejected':
      case 'verification_rejected':
      case 'update_rejected':
        return 'REJECTED';
      case 'under_review':
      case 'review_application':
        return 'UNDER REVIEW';
      case 'pending_verification':
        return 'PENDING VERIFICATION';
      case 'update_application':
        return 'UPDATE PENDING';
      case 'payment_pending':
        return 'PAYMENT PENDING';
      case 'submitted':
        return 'SUBMITTED';
      case 'pending':
      default:
        return 'PENDING';
    }
  }

  IconData _getStatusIcon(String status) {
    switch (status.toLowerCase()) {
      case 'approved':
      case 'approved_application':
      case 'verification_successful':
      case 'payment_verified':
        return Icons.verified;
      case 'completed':
      case 'final_submitted':
        return Icons.celebration;
      case 'rejected':
      case 'verification_rejected':
      case 'update_rejected':
        return Icons.cancel;
      case 'under_review':
      case 'review_application':
        return Icons.rate_review;
      case 'pending_verification':
      case 'payment_pending':
        return Icons.hourglass_empty;
      default:
        return Icons.pending;
    }
  }

  String _formatDate(String? dateStr) {
    if (dateStr == null || dateStr.isEmpty) return 'N/A';
    try {
      final date = DateTime.parse(dateStr);
      return '${date.day}/${date.month}/${date.year}';
    } catch (e) {
      return dateStr;
    }
  }

  IconData _iconForUrl(String url) {
    final u = url.toLowerCase();
    if (u.contains('.pdf') || u.contains('/raw/')) {
      return Icons.picture_as_pdf;
    }
    if (u.contains('.jpg') ||
        u.contains('.jpeg') ||
        u.contains('.png') ||
        u.contains('.webp') ||
        u.contains('.gif') ||
        u.contains('/image/')) {
      return Icons.image;
    }
    if (u.contains('.doc')) return Icons.description;
    if (u.contains('.xls')) return Icons.table_chart;
    return Icons.insert_drive_file;
  }

  Color _colorForUrl(String url) {
    final u = url.toLowerCase();
    if (u.contains('.pdf') || u.contains('/raw/')) return Colors.red;
    if (u.contains('.jpg') ||
        u.contains('.jpeg') ||
        u.contains('.png') ||
        u.contains('.webp') ||
        u.contains('.gif') ||
        u.contains('/image/')) {
      return Colors.blue;
    }
    if (u.contains('.doc')) return Colors.indigo;
    if (u.contains('.xls')) return Colors.green;
    return Colors.blueGrey;
  }

  String _fileTypeForUrl(String url) {
    final u = url.toLowerCase();
    if (u.contains('.pdf') || u.contains('/raw/')) return 'pdf';
    if (u.contains('.jpg') ||
        u.contains('.jpeg') ||
        u.contains('.png') ||
        u.contains('.webp') ||
        u.contains('.gif') ||
        u.contains('/image/')) return 'image';
    if (u.contains('.doc')) return 'word';
    if (u.contains('.xls')) return 'excel';
    return 'file';
  }

  // ============================================================
  // BUILD
  // ============================================================
  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    if (_selectedApplication != null) {
      return _buildApplicationDetailView(_selectedApplication!);
    }

    if (_isLoading && _applications.isEmpty) {
      return _buildLoadingScreen();
    }

    return Scaffold(
      backgroundColor: Colors.transparent,
      body: Container(
        decoration: _buildGradientBackground(),
        child: SafeArea(
          child: Column(
            children: [
              _buildHeader(),
              _buildFilterChips(),
              Expanded(
                child: _filteredApplications.isEmpty
                    ? _buildEmptyState()
                    : RefreshIndicator(
                        onRefresh: _refresh,
                        color: const Color(0xFF6C63FF),
                        child: ListView.builder(
                          padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
                          itemCount: _filteredApplications.length,
                          itemBuilder: (context, index) {
                            final app = _filteredApplications[index];
                            return _buildApplicationCard(app, index);
                          },
                        ),
                      ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  // ============================================================
  // FILTER CHIPS
  // ============================================================
  Widget _buildFilterChips() {
    return Container(
      height: 56,
      margin: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 12, bottom: 4),
      child: ListView.builder(
        scrollDirection: Axis.horizontal,
        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16),
        itemCount: _filterButtons.length,
        itemBuilder: (context, index) {
          final filter = _filterButtons[index];
          final isSelected = _selectedFilter == filter['value'];
          final Color color = filter['color'] as Color;

          return Padding(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 4),
            child: FilterChip(
              selected: isSelected,
              label: Row(
                mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                children: [
                  Icon(
                    filter['icon'] as IconData,
                    size: 14,
                    color: isSelected ? Colors.white : color,
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(width: 6),
                  Text(filter['label'] as String),
                ],
              ),
              onSelected: (selected) {
                _onFilterSelected(
                    selected ? filter['value'] as String : 'all');
              },
              backgroundColor: Colors.white.withOpacity(0.9),
              selectedColor: color,
              labelStyle: TextStyle(
                color: isSelected ? Colors.white : Colors.grey.shade700,
                fontWeight: isSelected ? FontWeight.bold : FontWeight.w500,
                fontSize: 12,
              ),
              shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20),
                side: BorderSide(
                  color: isSelected ? color : Colors.grey.shade300,
                  width: 1,
                ),
              ),
              elevation: isSelected ? 4 : 0,
            ),
          );
        },
      ),
    );
  }

      child: Row(
        mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
        children: [

          const SizedBox(width: 4),
