            style: TextStyle(
              fontSize: 10.5,
              color: color,
              fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  // ============================================================
  // ✅ APPLICATION DETAIL VIEW - READS FRESH _selectedApplication
  // ============================================================
  Widget _buildApplicationDetailView(Map<String, dynamic> app) {
    final schemeName = app['display_scheme_name'] ?? 'Government Scheme';
    final schemeNameHindi = app['display_scheme_name_hindi'] ?? schemeName;
    final schemeIcon = app['display_scheme_icon'] ?? '📋';
    final schemeLevel = app['display_scheme_level'] ?? 'Central';
    final schemeState = app['display_scheme_state'];
    final schemeCategory = app['display_scheme_category'] ?? 'other';

    final status = app['status'] ?? 'pending';
    final statusColor = _getStatusColor(status);
    final applicantName = app['applicant_name'] ?? 'Unknown';
    final applicantEmail = app['applicant_email'] ?? 'N/A';
    final appliedDate = _formatDate(app['created_at'] ?? app['applied_at']);

    final applicantDetails = app['applicant_details'] as Map? ?? {};
    final applicantAddress = app['applicant_address'] as Map? ?? {};
    final bankDetails = app['bank_details'] as Map? ?? {};

    // ✅ Determine which buttons to show based on status
    final statusLower = status.toLowerCase();
    final bool isFinalStatus = statusLower == 'rejected' ||
        statusLower == 'completed' ||
        statusLower == 'final_submitted' ||
        statusLower == 'verification_rejected';

    // Show review/final buttons for any non-final status
    final bool showActionButtons = !isFinalStatus;

    return Scaffold(
      backgroundColor: Colors.transparent,
      body: Container(
        decoration: _buildGradientBackground(),
        child: SafeArea(
          child: Column(
            children: [
              _buildDetailHeader(schemeIcon, schemeNameHindi),
              Expanded(
                child: SingleChildScrollView(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
                  child: Column(
                    crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                    children: [
                      // Status Card - updates automatically after refresh
                      _buildStatusCard(
                          app['application_id'], status, statusColor),
                      const SizedBox(height: 16),

                      // ✅ ACTION BUTTONS - Shown for ALL non-final statuses
                      if (showActionButtons) ...[
                        _buildAdminActionButtons(
                            app['application_id'], status),
                        const SizedBox(height: 16),
                      ],

                      // Scheme Information
                      _buildSchemeInfoCard(
                        schemeName,
                        schemeNameHindi,
                        schemeIcon,
                        schemeLevel,
                        schemeState,
                        schemeCategory,
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(height: 16),

                      // Applicant Information
                      _buildApplicantCard(
                        applicantName,
                        applicantEmail,
                        appliedDate,
                        applicantDetails,
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(height: 16),

                      // Address Information
                      if (applicantAddress.isNotEmpty)
                        _buildAddressCard(applicantAddress),
                      if (applicantAddress.isNotEmpty)
                        const SizedBox(height: 16),

                      // Bank Details
                      if (bankDetails.isNotEmpty) _buildBankCard(bankDetails),
                      if (bankDetails.isNotEmpty) const SizedBox(height: 16),

                      // ✅ ADMIN DOCUMENTS CARD - auto-refreshes after action
                      _buildAdminDocumentsCard(),
                      const SizedBox(height: 16),

                      // ✅ USER DOCUMENTS CARD
                      _buildUserDocumentsCard(),
                      const SizedBox(height: 20),

  // APPLICANT CARD

  Widget _buildApplicantCard(

  ) {

                    color: Color(0xFF6C63FF),
                  ),
                ),
              ),
              const SizedBox(width: 14),
              Expanded(
                child: Column(
                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                  children: [
                    Text(
                      name,
                      style: const TextStyle(
                        fontSize: 16,
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                        color: Colors.black87,
                      ),
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 2),
                    Text(
                      email,
                      style: TextStyle(
                        fontSize: 12,
                        color: Colors.grey.shade600,
                      ),
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 6),
                    Container(
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                        horizontal: 8,
                        vertical: 3,
                      ),
                      decoration: BoxDecoration(
                        color: Colors.blue.shade50,
                        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10),
                      ),
                      child: Row(
                        mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                        children: [
                          Icon(
                            Icons.calendar_today,
                            size: 11,
                            color: Colors.blue.shade700,
                          ),
                          const SizedBox(width: 4),
                          Text(
                            "Applied: $appliedDate",
                            style: TextStyle(
                              fontSize: 10.5,
                              color: Colors.blue.shade700,
                              fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                            ),
                          ),
                        ],
                      ),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
          if (applicantDetails.isNotEmpty) ...[
            const SizedBox(height: 16),
            const Divider(),
            const SizedBox(height: 8),
            if (applicantDetails['father_name'] != null &&
                applicantDetails['father_name'].toString().isNotEmpty)
              _buildInfoRow(
                Icons.family_restroom,
                "Father's Name",
                applicantDetails['father_name'].toString(),
              ),
            if (applicantDetails['date_of_birth'] != null &&
                applicantDetails['date_of_birth'].toString().isNotEmpty) ...[
              const SizedBox(height: 8),
              _buildInfoRow(
                Icons.cake,
                "Date of Birth",
                _formatDate(applicantDetails['date_of_birth'].toString()),
              ),
            ],
            if (applicantDetails['gender'] != null &&
                applicantDetails['gender'].toString().isNotEmpty) ...[
              const SizedBox(height: 8),
              _buildInfoRow(
                Icons.wc,
                "Gender",
                applicantDetails['gender'].toString().toUpperCase(),
              ),
            ],
            if (applicantDetails['category'] != null &&
                applicantDetails['category'].toString().isNotEmpty) ...[
              const SizedBox(height: 8),
              _buildInfoRow(
                Icons.category,
                "Category",
                applicantDetails['category'].toString(),
              ),
            ],
            if (applicantDetails['mobile'] != null &&
                applicantDetails['mobile'].toString().isNotEmpty) ...[
              const SizedBox(height: 8),
              _buildInfoRow(
                Icons.phone,
                "Mobile",
                applicantDetails['mobile'].toString(),
              ),
            ],
            if (applicantDetails['annual_income'] != null) ...[
              const SizedBox(height: 8),
              _buildInfoRow(
                Icons.currency_rupee,
                "Annual Income",
                "₹${applicantDetails['annual_income']}",
                color: Colors.green,
              ),
            ],
          ],
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  // ============================================================
  // BANK CARD
  // ============================================================
  Widget _buildBankCard(Map bankDetails) {
    return _buildGlassContainer(
      child: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
        children: [
          _sectionHeader("Bank Details", Icons.account_balance_wallet),
          if (bankDetails['account_holder_name'] != null &&
              bankDetails['account_holder_name'].toString().isNotEmpty)
            _buildInfoRow(
              Icons.person,
              "Account Holder",
              bankDetails['account_holder_name'].toString(),
            ),
          if (bankDetails['bank_name'] != null &&
              bankDetails['bank_name'].toString().isNotEmpty) ...[
            const SizedBox(height: 8),
            _buildInfoRow(
              Icons.account_balance,
              "Bank Name",
              bankDetails['bank_name'].toString(),
            ),
          ],
          if (bankDetails['account_number'] != null &&
              bankDetails['account_number'].toString().isNotEmpty) ...[
            const SizedBox(height: 8),
            _buildInfoRow(
              Icons.numbers,
              "Account Number",
              _maskAccountNumber(bankDetails['account_number'].toString()),
            ),
          ],
          if (bankDetails['ifsc_code'] != null &&
              bankDetails['ifsc_code'].toString().isNotEmpty) ...[
            const SizedBox(height: 8),
            _buildInfoRow(
              Icons.code,
              "IFSC Code",
              bankDetails['ifsc_code'].toString(),
            ),
          ],
          if (bankDetails['branch_name'] != null &&
              bankDetails['branch_name'].toString().isNotEmpty) ...[
            const SizedBox(height: 8),
            _buildInfoRow(
              Icons.location_on,
              "Branch",
              bankDetails['branch_name'].toString(),
            ),
          ],
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  String _maskAccountNumber(String accountNumber) {
    if (accountNumber.length > 4) {
      return '${'*' * (accountNumber.length - 4)}${accountNumber.substring(accountNumber.length - 4)}';
    }
    return accountNumber;
  }

                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                ),
                child: const Icon(
                  Icons.admin_panel_settings,
                  color: Colors.white,
                  size: 22,
                ),
              ),
              const SizedBox(width: 12),
              const Expanded(
                child: Column(
                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                  children: [
                    Text(
                      "Admin Uploaded Documents",
                      style: TextStyle(
                        fontSize: 15,
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                        color: Colors.black87,
                      ),
                    ),
                    SizedBox(height: 2),
                    Text(
                      "Uploaded via Review / Final Submit",
                      style: TextStyle(fontSize: 11, color: Colors.grey),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
              Container(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                  horizontal: 10,
                  vertical: 4,
                ),
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  color: Colors.purple.shade50,
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                ),
                child: Text(
                  "$count ${count == 1 ? 'File' : 'Files'}",
                  style: const TextStyle(
                    fontSize: 11,
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                    color: Colors.purple,
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 14),
          if (_isLoadingDocuments)
            const Padding(
              padding: EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 20),
              child: Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator()),
            )
          else if (count == 0)
            Container(
              width: double.infinity,
              padding: const EdgeInsets.all(20),
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                color: Colors.grey.shade100,
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
              ),
              child: const Column(
                children: [
                  Icon(Icons.folder_off, size: 40, color: Colors.grey),
                  SizedBox(height: 8),
                  Text(
                    "No admin documents uploaded yet",
                    style: TextStyle(color: Colors.grey),
                  ),
                  SizedBox(height: 4),
                  Text(
                    "Documents uploaded via Review or Final Submit will appear here",
                    style: TextStyle(fontSize: 11, color: Colors.grey),
                    textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            )
          else
            Column(
              children: _adminDocuments
                  .asMap()
                  .entries
                  .map((e) => _buildAdminDocumentRow(e.key, e.value))
                  .toList(),
            ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

                  "$count ${count == 1 ? 'File' : 'Files'}",
                  style: const TextStyle(
                    fontSize: 11,
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                    color: Colors.blue,
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 14),
          if (_isLoadingDocuments)
            const Padding(
              padding: EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 20),
              child: Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator()),
            )
          else if (count == 0)
            Container(
              width: double.infinity,
              padding: const EdgeInsets.all(20),
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                color: Colors.grey.shade100,
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
              ),
              child: const Column(
                children: [
                  Icon(Icons.folder_off, size: 40, color: Colors.grey),
                  SizedBox(height: 8),
                  Text(
                    "No user documents uploaded yet",
                    style: TextStyle(color: Colors.grey),
                  ),
                  SizedBox(height: 4),
                  Text(
                    "Candidate has not uploaded any documents",
                    style: TextStyle(fontSize: 11, color: Colors.grey),
                    textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            )
          else
            Column(
              children: _userDocuments
                  .asMap()
                  .entries
                  .map((e) => _buildUserDocumentRow(e.key, e.value))
                  .toList(),
            ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  // ============================================================
  // ✅ ADMIN DOCUMENT ROW
  // ============================================================
  Widget _buildAdminDocumentRow(int index, Map<String, dynamic> doc) {
    final String label =
        doc['label']?.toString() ?? 'Admin Document ${index + 1}';
    final String url = doc['url']?.toString() ?? '';
    final String? downloadUrl = doc['download_url']?.toString();
    final String badge = doc['badge']?.toString() ?? 'ADMIN';
    final Color badgeColor = doc['badgeColor'] is Color
        ? doc['badgeColor'] as Color
        : Colors.purple;

    final icon = _iconForUrl(url);
    final color = _colorForUrl(url);
    final fileType = _fileTypeForUrl(url);

    return Container(
      margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 10),
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: Colors.purple.shade50,
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
        border: Border.all(color: Colors.purple.shade200),
      ),
      child: Row(
        children: [
          Container(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.all(10),
            decoration: BoxDecoration(
              color: color.withOpacity(0.15),
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10),
            ),
            child: Icon(icon, color: color, size: 24),
          ),
          const SizedBox(width: 12),
          Expanded(
            child: Column(
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
              children: [
                Text(
                  label,
                  style: const TextStyle(
                    fontSize: 13.5,
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                    color: Colors.black87,
                  ),
                  maxLines: 2,
                  overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 3),
                Row(
                  children: [
                    Container(
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                        horizontal: 6,
                        vertical: 2,
                      ),
                      decoration: BoxDecoration(
                        color: badgeColor,
                        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(6),
                      ),
                      child: Text(
                        badge,
                        style: const TextStyle(
                          fontSize: 8,
                          fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                          color: Colors.white,
                        ),
                      ),
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(width: 6),
                    Text(
                      fileType.toUpperCase(),
                      style: TextStyle(
                        fontSize: 10,
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w500,
                        color: Colors.grey.shade600,
                      ),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
          IconButton(
            icon: const Icon(Icons.visibility, color: Colors.purple),
            tooltip: "View",
            onPressed: () => _openDocumentViewer(
              url,
              title: label,
              downloadUrl: downloadUrl,
              fileType: fileType,
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  // ============================================================
  // ✅ USER DOCUMENT ROW
  // ============================================================
  Widget _buildUserDocumentRow(int index, Map<String, dynamic> doc) {
    final String label = doc['label']?.toString() ?? 'Document ${index + 1}';
    final String url = doc['url']?.toString() ?? '';
    final String? downloadUrl = doc['download_url']?.toString();

    final icon = _iconForUrl(url);
    final color = _colorForUrl(url);
    final fileType = _fileTypeForUrl(url);

    const badgeLabel = "UPLOADED";
    const badgeColor = Colors.green;

    return Container(
      margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 10),
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: Colors.blue.shade50,
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
        border: Border.all(color: Colors.blue.shade200),
      ),
      child: Row(
        children: [
          Container(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.all(10),
            decoration: BoxDecoration(
              color: color.withOpacity(0.15),
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10),
            ),
            child: Icon(icon, color: color, size: 24),
          ),
          const SizedBox(width: 12),
          Expanded(
            child: Column(
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
              children: [
                Text(
                  label,
                  style: const TextStyle(
                    fontSize: 13.5,
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                    color: Colors.black87,
                  ),
                  maxLines: 2,
                  overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 3),
                Row(
                  children: [
                    Container(
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                        horizontal: 6,
                        vertical: 2,
                      ),
                      decoration: BoxDecoration(
                        color: badgeColor.withOpacity(0.15),
                        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(6),
                        border: Border.all(
                          color: badgeColor.withOpacity(0.4),
                        ),
                      ),
                      child: const Text(
                        badgeLabel,
                        style: TextStyle(
                          fontSize: 8,
                          fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                          color: badgeColor,
                        ),
                      ),
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(width: 6),
                    Text(
                      fileType.toUpperCase(),
                      style: TextStyle(
                        fontSize: 10,
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w500,
                        color: Colors.grey.shade600,
                      ),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
          IconButton(
            icon: const Icon(Icons.visibility, color: Colors.blue),
            tooltip: "View",
            onPressed: () => _openDocumentViewer(
              url,
              title: label,
              downloadUrl: downloadUrl,
              fileType: fileType,
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  // ============================================================
  // SECTION HEADER
  // ============================================================
  Widget _sectionHeader(String title, IconData icon) {
    return Padding(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 12),
      child: Row(
        children: [
          Container(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.all(8),
            decoration: BoxDecoration(
              gradient: const LinearGradient(
                colors: [Color(0xFF6C63FF), Color(0xFFFF6588)],
              ),
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10),
            ),
            child: Icon(icon, color: Colors.white, size: 18),
          ),
          const SizedBox(width: 12),
          Expanded(
            child: Text(
              title,
              style: const TextStyle(
                fontSize: 16,
                fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                color: Colors.black87,
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  // ============================================================
  // INFO ROW
  // ============================================================
  Widget _buildInfoRow(IconData icon, String label, String value,
      {Color? color}) {
    if (value.isEmpty || value == 'N/A') return const SizedBox();
    return Padding(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 4),
      child: Row(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
        children: [
          Icon(icon, size: 18, color: color ?? Colors.grey.shade600),
          const SizedBox(width: 12),
          SizedBox(
            width: 110,
            child: Text(
              label,
              style: TextStyle(
                fontSize: 12.5,
                color: Colors.grey.shade600,
              ),
            ),
          ),
          Expanded(
            child: Text(
              value,
              style: TextStyle(
                fontSize: 13,
                fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                color: color ?? Colors.black87,
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  // ============================================================
  // GLASS CONTAINER
  // ============================================================
  Widget _buildGlassContainer({required Widget child}) {
    return Container(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: Colors.white.withOpacity(0.85),
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20),
        border: Border.all(color: Colors.white.withOpacity(0.5), width: 1),
        boxShadow: [
          BoxShadow(
            color: Colors.grey.withOpacity(0.1),
            blurRadius: 15,
            spreadRadius: 5,
          ),
        ],
      ),
      child: child,
    );
  }
}

// ============================================================================
// ✅ REVIEW DIALOG CONTENT - FIXED for WEB + MOBILE
// ============================================================================
class _ReviewDialogContent extends StatefulWidget {
  final TextEditingController notesController;

  const _ReviewDialogContent({
    required this.notesController,
  });

  @override
  State<_ReviewDialogContent> createState() => _ReviewDialogContentState();
}

class _ReviewDialogContentState extends State<_ReviewDialogContent> {
  String? _selectedFileName;
  Uint8List? _selectedFileBytes;
  bool _isPicking = false;

  Future<void> _pickFile() async {
    debugPrint("=" * 70);
    debugPrint("📁 REVIEW _pickFile called");
    debugPrint("   Platform: ${kIsWeb ? 'WEB' : 'MOBILE'}");
    debugPrint("   _isPicking: $_isPicking");
    debugPrint("=" * 70);

    if (_isPicking) return;

    setState(() => _isPicking = true);

    try {
      debugPrint("📁 Calling FilePicker.platform.pickFiles...");

      final result = await FilePicker.platform.pickFiles(
        type: FileType.custom,
        allowedExtensions: ['pdf', 'jpg', 'jpeg', 'png'],
        withData: true,
      );

      debugPrint("📁 FilePicker returned: ${result?.files.length ?? 0} files");

      if (result == null || result.files.isEmpty) {
        debugPrint("⚠️ No file selected");
        if (mounted) setState(() => _isPicking = false);
        return;
      }

      final file = result.files.first;

      debugPrint("=" * 60);
      debugPrint("📁 REVIEW FILE PICKED");
      debugPrint("   Name: ${file.name}");
      debugPrint("   Size: ${file.size} bytes");
      debugPrint("   Bytes available: ${file.bytes != null}");
      debugPrint("   Path: ${kIsWeb ? '(web - not available)' : file.path}");
      debugPrint("   Extension: ${file.extension}");
      debugPrint("=" * 60);

      Uint8List? bytes = file.bytes;

      if ((bytes == null || bytes.isEmpty) && !kIsWeb) {
        if (file.path != null && file.path!.isNotEmpty) {
          try {
            final f = File(file.path!);
            if (await f.exists()) {
              bytes = await f.readAsBytes();
              debugPrint("📱 MOBILE: Read ${bytes.length} bytes from path");
            }
          } catch (e) {
            debugPrint("❌ MOBILE: Failed to read from path: $e");
          }
        }
      }

      if (bytes == null || bytes.isEmpty) {
        debugPrint("❌ No file bytes available");
        if (mounted) {
          showMessage(
            context,
            kIsWeb
                ? "Could not read file. Please try a different browser or file."
                : "Could not read file. Please try again.",
            isError: true,
          );
          setState(() => _isPicking = false);
        }
        return;
      }

      const maxSize = 10 * 1024 * 1024;
      if (bytes.length > maxSize) {
        if (mounted) {
          showMessage(
            context,
            "File too large. Max: 10MB, Your file: ${(bytes.length / (1024 * 1024)).toStringAsFixed(1)}MB",
            isError: true,
          );
          setState(() => _isPicking = false);
        }
        return;
      }

      if (mounted) {
        setState(() {
          _selectedFileName = file.name;
          _selectedFileBytes = bytes;
          _isPicking = false;
        });
        debugPrint("✅ REVIEW file ready: ${file.name} (${bytes.length} bytes)");
      }
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint("❌ REVIEW _pickFile error: $e");
      if (mounted) {
        showMessage(context, "Error picking file: $e", isError: true);
        setState(() => _isPicking = false);
      }
    }
  }

  void _clearFile() {
    setState(() {
      _selectedFileName = null;
      _selectedFileBytes = null;
    });
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final screenWidth = MediaQuery.of(context).size.width;
    final dialogWidth = screenWidth * 0.9 > 500 ? 500.0 : screenWidth * 0.9;
    final bool canSubmit =
        _selectedFileName != null && _selectedFileBytes != null;

    return Dialog(
      shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(24)),
      backgroundColor: Colors.white,
      child: Container(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(20),
        width: dialogWidth,
        constraints: BoxConstraints(
          maxHeight: MediaQuery.of(context).size.height * 0.85,
        ),
        child: Column(
          mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
          children: [
            Row(
              children: [
                Container(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.all(10),
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                    gradient: const LinearGradient(
                      colors: [Color(0xFF6C63FF), Color(0xFFFF6588)],
                    ),
                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
                  ),
                  child: const Icon(
                    Icons.rate_review,
                    color: Colors.white,
                    size: 26,
                  ),
                ),
                const SizedBox(width: 14),
                const Expanded(
                  child: Text(
                    "Review Application",
                    style: TextStyle(
                      fontSize: 20,
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                      color: Colors.black87,
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
                IconButton(
                  icon: const Icon(Icons.close, size: 24),
                  onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(context, null),
                ),
              ],
            ),
            const Divider(height: 24),

            Container(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
              margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 16),
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                color: const Color(0xFF6C63FF).withOpacity(0.08),
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                border: Border.all(
                  color: const Color(0xFF6C63FF).withOpacity(0.2),
                ),
              ),
              child: Row(
                children: [
                  const Icon(
                    Icons.info_outline,
                    color: Color(0xFF6C63FF),
                    size: 18,
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(width: 10),
                  Expanded(
                    child: Text(
                      "This will change status to REVIEW. Document is required.",
                      style: TextStyle(
                        fontSize: 12,
                        color: const Color(0xFF6C63FF).withOpacity(0.9),
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),

            Flexible(
              child: SingleChildScrollView(
                child: Column(
                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                  children: [
                    const Text(
                      "📄 Upload Document (PDF or Image) *",
                      style: TextStyle(
                        fontSize: 15,
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                      ),
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 8),
                    Text(
                      "Upload relevant document for review. (Required)",
                      style: TextStyle(
                        fontSize: 12,
                        color: Colors.grey.shade600,
                      ),
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 12),

                    GestureDetector(
                      onTap: _isPicking ? null : _pickFile,
                      child: Container(
                        width: double.infinity,
                        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                          vertical: 20,
                          horizontal: 16,
                        ),
                        decoration: BoxDecoration(
                          color: _selectedFileName != null
                              ? Colors.green.shade50
                              : Colors.blue.shade50,
                          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
                          border: Border.all(
                            color: _selectedFileName != null
                                ? Colors.green
                                : Colors.blue,
                            width: 2,
                          ),
                        ),
                        child: Column(
                          children: [
                            if (_isPicking)
                              const CircularProgressIndicator()
                            else
                              Icon(
                                _selectedFileName != null
                                    ? Icons.check_circle
                                    : Icons.cloud_upload,
                                size: 44,
                                color: _selectedFileName != null
                                    ? Colors.green
                                    : Colors.blue,
                              ),
                            const SizedBox(height: 12),
                            Text(
                              _isPicking
                                  ? "Loading file..."
                                  : (_selectedFileName ??
                                      "Tap to select document"),
                              style: TextStyle(
                                fontSize: 14,
                                fontWeight: _selectedFileName != null
                                    ? FontWeight.bold
                                    : FontWeight.normal,
                                color: _selectedFileName != null
                                    ? Colors.green.shade700
                                    : Colors.blue.shade700,
                              ),
                              textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                            ),
                            if (_selectedFileName != null &&
                                _selectedFileBytes != null) ...[
                              const SizedBox(height: 4),
                              Text(
                                "${(_selectedFileBytes!.length / 1024).toStringAsFixed(1)} KB",
                                style: TextStyle(
                                  fontSize: 11,
                                  color: Colors.grey.shade600,
                                ),
                              ),
                              const SizedBox(height: 8),
                              GestureDetector(
                                onTap: _clearFile,
                                child: Container(
                                  padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                                    horizontal: 12,
                                    vertical: 4,
                                  ),
                                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                                    color: Colors.red.shade50,
                                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                                    border: Border.all(
                                      color: Colors.red.shade200,
                                    ),
                                  ),
                                  child: const Row(
                                    mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                                    children: [
                                      Icon(
                                        Icons.close,
                                        size: 12,
                                        color: Colors.red,
                                      ),
                                      SizedBox(width: 4),
                                      Text(
                                        "Remove",
                                        style: TextStyle(
                                          fontSize: 11,
                                          color: Colors.red,
                                        ),
                                      ),
                                    ],
                                  ),
                                ),
                              ),
                            ],
                          ],
                        ),
                      ),
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 20),

                    const Text(
                      "Review Notes (Optional)",
                      style: TextStyle(
                        fontSize: 14,
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                      ),
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 8),
                    TextField(
                      controller: widget.notesController,
                      maxLines: 3,
                      decoration: InputDecoration(
                        hintText: "Add review comments or notes...",
                        border: OutlineInputBorder(
                          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                        ),
                        contentPadding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
                      ),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 20),

            Row(
              children: [
                Expanded(
                  child: OutlinedButton(
                    onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(context, null),
                    style: OutlinedButton.styleFrom(
                      foregroundColor: Colors.grey.shade700,
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 14),
                      shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
                        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                      ),
                      side: BorderSide(color: Colors.grey.shade400),
                    ),
                    child: const Text(
                      "Cancel",
                      style: TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w600),
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
                const SizedBox(width: 12),
                Expanded(
                  child: Container(
                    decoration: BoxDecoration(
                      gradient: LinearGradient(
                        colors: canSubmit
                            ? [const Color(0xFF6C63FF), const Color(0xFF8B7FFF)]
                            : [Colors.grey.shade300, Colors.grey.shade400],
                      ),
                      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                      boxShadow: canSubmit
                          ? [
                              BoxShadow(
                                color: const Color(0xFF6C63FF)
                                    .withOpacity(0.3),
                                blurRadius: 10,
                                spreadRadius: 1,
                              ),
                            ]
                          : null,
                    ),
                    child: ElevatedButton(
                      onPressed: canSubmit
                          ? () {
                              debugPrint("=" * 60);
                              debugPrint("📤 REVIEW SUBMITTING");
                              debugPrint("   File: $_selectedFileName");
                              debugPrint(
                                  "   Bytes: ${_selectedFileBytes!.length}");
                              debugPrint(
                                  "   Notes: ${widget.notesController.text}");
                              debugPrint("=" * 60);

                              Navigator.pop(context, {
                                'hasFile': true,
                                'fileBytes': _selectedFileBytes,
                                'fileName': _selectedFileName,
                                'notes': widget.notesController.text,
                              });
                            }
                          : null,
                      style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(
                        backgroundColor: Colors.transparent,
                        foregroundColor: Colors.white,
                        disabledBackgroundColor: Colors.transparent,
                        shadowColor: Colors.transparent,
                        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 14),
                        shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
                          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                        ),
                      ),
                      child: const Row(
                        mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
                        children: [
                          Icon(Icons.rate_review, size: 18),
                          SizedBox(width: 8),
                          Text(
                            "Submit Review",
                            style: TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.bold),
                          ),
                        ],
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

// ✅ FINAL SUBMIT DIALOG CONTENT - FIXED for WEB + MOBILE

        }
        return;
      }

            context,
            "File too large. Max: 10MB, Your file: ${(bytes.length / (1024 * 1024)).toStringAsFixed(1)}MB",

          );
          setState(() => _isPicking = false);
        }
        return;
      }

      if (mounted) {
        setState(() {
          _selectedFileName = file.name;
          _selectedFileBytes = bytes;
          _isPicking = false;
        });
        debugPrint(
            "✅ FINAL SUBMIT file ready: ${file.name} (${bytes.length} bytes)");
      }
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint("❌ FINAL SUBMIT _pickFile error: $e");
      if (mounted) {
        showMessage(context, "Error picking file: $e", isError: true);
        setState(() => _isPicking = false);
      }
    }
  }

  void _clearFile() {
    setState(() {
      _selectedFileName = null;
      _selectedFileBytes = null;
    });
  }

// lib/features/schemes/presentation/screens/scheme_apply_screen.dart

// ✅ FIXED: Added http import
// ✅ REMOVED: Bank Details Tab (auto-filled from profile)
// ✅ REMOVED: Aadhaar Card number field (auto-filled from profile)
// ✅ REMOVED: Back button from AppBar (automaticallyImplyLeading: false)
// ✅ Tabs shown for: Personal Details, Address, Documents
// ✅ CRITICAL FIX: Payment is now REQUIRED before application creation
// ✅ CRITICAL FIX: Always shows APPLICATION NUMBER (not application_id)
// ✅ NEW: PaymentScreen now returns Map<String, dynamic>? (not bool?)
// ✅ NEW: Success dialog shows Application Number prominently
// ✅ ✅ ✅ CRITICAL LOGOUT FIX (2026-10-15):
//      - Removed `Navigator.pop(context)` after success dialog.
//      - Added `onApplicationSubmitted` callback for the parent to handle navigation.
//      - Added `_resetAfterSuccess()` helper that resets local state ONLY.
//      - Works correctly in BOTH fullscreen and inline/embedded modes.
//      - This mirrors the Jobs/Services pattern which never popped the parent route.
// ✅ ✅ ✅ NEW FIX (2026-10-16): APPLICATION NUMBER NOW SHOWS CORRECTLY
//      - Scheme backend uses `application_id` field as the human-readable
//        Application Number (e.g. "20261000020"), NOT a Mongo ObjectId.
//      - `_resolveApplicationNumber()` now prioritizes:
//          1. top-level `application_number`
//          2. top-level `application_id` (if non-Mongo)
//          3. nested `data.application_number`
//          4. nested `data.application_id` (if non-Mongo)
//          5. detail endpoint: `application.application_number`
//          6. detail endpoint: `application.application_id` (if non-Mongo)
//          7. detail endpoint: `data.application_number`
//          8. detail endpoint: `data.application.application_number`
//      - Mongo ObjectId (24-char hex) is NEVER used for display.
//      - If nothing resolves, dialog shows "Generating…" instead of a wrong ID.
// ✅ ✅ ✅ NEW FIX (2026-10-17): SUCCESS DIALOG NOW SHOWS "PAYMENT SUCCESSFULLY"
//      - Previously the dialog showed `status: "pending"` (the scheme
//        review status from the backend `/schemes/apply` response).
//      - Jobs and Services show "payment_verified" because they pull
//        the status from the PAYMENT VERIFICATION response, not the
//        application response.
//      - Now scheme flow does the same: the success dialog receives
//          • status: 'payment_verified' (or the paymentResult['status'])
//          • paymentId: the Razorpay payment ID (razorpay_payment_id)
//        so the "Status" row shows PAYMENT VERIFIED / PAYMENT SUCCESSFUL
//        exactly like Job and Service flows.
// ✅ ✅ ✅ NEW FIX (2026-10-17): REMOVED "Address Line 2" FIELD
//      - The `addressLine2Ctrl` controller has been removed.
//      - The "Address Line 2" read-only field is no longer rendered.
//      - The auto-fill line for `address_line2` is gone.
//      - The `address_line2` key is no longer sent in the applicant
//        address payload to `/payment/razorpay/create-order` or
//        `/schemes/apply`.
//      - All other address fields (Address Line 1, Village/City,
//        District, State, Pincode, Country) remain untouched.

// ============================================================
// SCHEME APPLY SCREEN
// ============================================================

class SchemeApplyScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  final GovernmentScheme scheme;

  /// ✅ NEW: Callback invoked when the application is submitted successfully
  /// (i.e. user tapped "Done" on the success dialog).
  ///
  /// The SchemeApplyScreen NEVER calls `Navigator.pop(context)` on success.
  /// Instead it delegates navigation to the parent via this callback.
  ///
  /// - In inline/embedded mode (UserDashboard panel), the parent closes
  ///   the inline apply view without touching the dashboard route.
  /// - In fullscreen mode, the parent can simply `Navigator.pop(context)`.
  final VoidCallback? onApplicationSubmitted;

  const SchemeApplyScreen({
    super.key,
    required this.scheme,
    this.onApplicationSubmitted,
  });

  @override
  State<SchemeApplyScreen> createState() => _SchemeApplyScreenState();
}

class _SchemeApplyScreenState extends State<SchemeApplyScreen>
    with TickerProviderStateMixin {
  // ============================================================
  // TAB CONTROLLER
  // ============================================================
  late TabController _tabController;
  int _currentTabIndex = 0;

  // ✅ ONLY 3 TABS NOW (Bank Details tab REMOVED)
  final List<String> _tabLabels = const [
    'Personal Details',
    'Address Details',
    'Documents',
  ];

  final List<IconData> _tabIcons = const [
    Icons.person,
    Icons.location_on,
    Icons.upload_file,
  ];

  // ============================================================
  // ✅ BANK-RELATED FIELDS TO EXCLUDE FROM WARNING
  // ============================================================
  static const Set<String> _bankRelatedFields = {
    'bank_name',
    'bank_account',
    'account_number',
    'ifsc_code',
    'branch_name',
    'account_holder_name',
    'account_type',
    'bank_details',
    'aadhaar_number',
    'aadhar_number',
    'aadhaar_card',
    'aadhar_card',
  };

  // ============================================================
  // ✅ FEE CONSTANTS — SAME AS JOB & SERVICE
  // ============================================================
  static const double GST_PERCENT = 18.0;
  static const int SERVICE_CHARGE = 50;
  static const int BASE_SCHEME_FEE = 0; // Schemes are typically free

  // ============================================================
  // LOADING STATES
  // ============================================================
  bool _isLoadingProfile = true;
  bool _isSubmitting = false;
  bool _profileComplete = false;
  List<String> _missingFields = [];

  // ✅ Payment state
  bool _isPaymentProcessing = false;
  bool _paymentCompleted = false;
  String? _razorpayOrderId;
  String? _paymentId;

  // ✅ NEW: Track the actual Razorpay payment ID for the success dialog
  String? _razorpayPaymentId;

  // ============================================================
  // PROFILE DATA (Auto-filled)
  // ============================================================
  Map<String, dynamic> _profileData = {};

  // ============================================================
  // PERSONAL DETAILS (Read-only, auto-filled from profile)
  // ============================================================
  final TextEditingController fullNameCtrl = TextEditingController();
  final TextEditingController fatherNameCtrl = TextEditingController();
  final TextEditingController motherNameCtrl = TextEditingController();
  final TextEditingController dobCtrl = TextEditingController();
  final TextEditingController genderCtrl = TextEditingController();
  final TextEditingController categoryCtrl = TextEditingController();
  final TextEditingController maritalStatusCtrl = TextEditingController();
  final TextEditingController mobileCtrl = TextEditingController();
  final TextEditingController emailCtrl = TextEditingController();
  final TextEditingController annualIncomeCtrl = TextEditingController();
  final TextEditingController disabilityStatusCtrl = TextEditingController();

  // ============================================================
  // ADDRESS DETAILS (Read-only, auto-filled from profile)
  // ✅ REMOVED: addressLine2Ctrl (Address Line 2 removed per request)
  // ============================================================
  final TextEditingController addressLine1Ctrl = TextEditingController();
  final TextEditingController villageCityCtrl = TextEditingController();
  final TextEditingController districtCtrl = TextEditingController();
  final TextEditingController stateCtrl = TextEditingController();
  final TextEditingController pincodeCtrl = TextEditingController();
  final TextEditingController countryCtrl = TextEditingController();

  // ============================================================
  // DOCUMENTS (User uploads)
  // ============================================================
  final Map<String, Map<String, dynamic>> _uploadedDocuments = {};
  bool _isUploadingDoc = false;
  String? _uploadingDocType;

  // ============================================================
  // FEE CALCULATION
  // ============================================================
  int get _applicationFee => BASE_SCHEME_FEE;
  int get _serviceCharge => SERVICE_CHARGE;
  int get _subtotal => _applicationFee + _serviceCharge;
  int get _gstAmount => ((_subtotal * GST_PERCENT) / 100).round();
  int get _totalFee => _subtotal + _gstAmount;

  // ============================================================
  // INIT
  // ============================================================
  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _tabController = TabController(length: _tabLabels.length, vsync: this);
    _tabController.addListener(() {
      if (mounted && _currentTabIndex != _tabController.index) {
        setState(() => _currentTabIndex = _tabController.index);
      }
    });
    _loadProfileData();
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _tabController.dispose();
    fullNameCtrl.dispose();
    fatherNameCtrl.dispose();
    motherNameCtrl.dispose();
    dobCtrl.dispose();
    genderCtrl.dispose();
    categoryCtrl.dispose();
    maritalStatusCtrl.dispose();
    mobileCtrl.dispose();
    emailCtrl.dispose();
    annualIncomeCtrl.dispose();
    disabilityStatusCtrl.dispose();
    addressLine1Ctrl.dispose();
    // ✅ REMOVED: addressLine2Ctrl.dispose();
    villageCityCtrl.dispose();
    districtCtrl.dispose();
    stateCtrl.dispose();
    pincodeCtrl.dispose();
    countryCtrl.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  // ============================================================
  // LOAD PROFILE DATA FROM BACKEND
  // ============================================================
  Future<void> _loadProfileData() async {
    setState(() => _isLoadingProfile = true);

    try {
      debugPrint("=" * 70);
      debugPrint("📥 LOADING PROFILE DATA FOR SCHEME APPLICATION");
      debugPrint("   Scheme: ${widget.scheme.schemeName}");
      debugPrint("=" * 70);

      final response = await DioClient.dio.get('/schemes/profile-data');

      if (response.data['success'] == true) {
        _profileData = response.data;

        final rawMissingFields = List<String>.from(
          response.data['missing_fields'] ?? [],
        );

        _missingFields = rawMissingFields
            .where((field) =>
                !_bankRelatedFields.contains(field.toLowerCase()))
            .toList();

        _profileComplete = _missingFields.isEmpty;

        debugPrint("✅ Profile data loaded");
        debugPrint("   Raw Missing Fields: $rawMissingFields");
        debugPrint("   Filtered Missing Fields: $_missingFields");
        debugPrint("   Profile Complete: $_profileComplete");

        _autoFillPersonalDetails(response.data['applicant_details'] ?? {});
        _autoFillAddressDetails(response.data['applicant_address'] ?? {});
      } else {
        throw Exception(response.data['message'] ?? 'Failed to load profile');
      }
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint("❌ Failed to load profile: $e");
      if (mounted) {
        showMessage(
          context,
          "Failed to load profile: ${e.toString()}",
          isError: true,
        );
      }
    } finally {
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() => _isLoadingProfile = false);
      }
    }
  }

  void _autoFillPersonalDetails(Map<String, dynamic> details) {
    fullNameCtrl.text = details['full_name']?.toString() ?? '';
    fatherNameCtrl.text = details['father_name']?.toString() ?? '';
    motherNameCtrl.text = details['mother_name']?.toString() ?? '';
    dobCtrl.text = details['date_of_birth']?.toString() ?? '';
    genderCtrl.text = _capitalizeFirst(details['gender']?.toString() ?? '');
    categoryCtrl.text = details['category']?.toString() ?? 'General';
    maritalStatusCtrl.text = details['marital_status']?.toString() ?? 'Unmarried';
    mobileCtrl.text = details['mobile']?.toString() ?? '';
    emailCtrl.text = details['email']?.toString() ?? '';
    annualIncomeCtrl.text = details['annual_income']?.toString() ?? '0';

    final disabilityStatus = details['disability_status'] == true;
    final disabilityPercentage = details['disability_percentage'];
    if (disabilityStatus) {
      disabilityStatusCtrl.text = disabilityPercentage != null &&
              disabilityPercentage > 0
          ? 'Yes (${disabilityPercentage.toStringAsFixed(0)}%)'
          : 'Yes';
    } else {
      disabilityStatusCtrl.text = 'No';
    }

    debugPrint("✅ Personal details auto-filled");
  }

  void _autoFillAddressDetails(Map<String, dynamic> address) {
    addressLine1Ctrl.text = address['address_line1']?.toString() ?? '';
    // ✅ REMOVED: addressLine2Ctrl.text = address['address_line2']?.toString() ?? '';
    villageCityCtrl.text = address['village_city']?.toString() ?? '';
    districtCtrl.text = address['district']?.toString() ?? '';
    stateCtrl.text = address['state']?.toString() ?? '';
    pincodeCtrl.text = address['pincode']?.toString() ?? '';
    countryCtrl.text = address['country']?.toString() ?? 'India';

    debugPrint("✅ Address details auto-filled");
  }

  String _capitalizeFirst(String s) {
    if (s.isEmpty) return s;
    return s[0].toUpperCase() + s.substring(1).toLowerCase();
  }

  // ============================================================
  // DOCUMENT UPLOAD
  // ============================================================
  Future<void> _pickAndUploadDocument(String docType, String docName) async {
    if (_isUploadingDoc) return;

    try {
      List<String> allowedExtensions = ['pdf', 'jpg', 'jpeg', 'png'];

      final result = await FilePicker.platform.pickFiles(
        type: FileType.custom,
        allowedExtensions: allowedExtensions,
        withData: true,
      );

      if (result == null || result.files.isEmpty) return;

      final file = result.files.first;

      if (file.size > 10 * 1024 * 1024) {
        if (mounted) {
          showMessage(
            context,
            "File too large. Maximum 10MB allowed.",
            isError: true,
          );
        }
        return;
      }

      setState(() {
        _isUploadingDoc = true;
        _uploadingDocType = docType;
      });

      final token = await SecureStorage.getToken();
      if (token == null) {
        throw Exception("No authentication token found");
      }

      final uri = Uri.parse(
        '${ApiConfig.baseUrl}/schemes/upload-temp-document',
      );

      final request = http.MultipartRequest('POST', uri);
      request.headers['Authorization'] = 'Bearer $token';

      final multipartFile = http.MultipartFile.fromBytes(
        'file',
        file.bytes!,
        filename: file.name,
        contentType: _getMimeType(file.name),
      );
      request.files.add(multipartFile);

      request.fields['document_type'] = docType;
      request.fields['document_name'] = docName;

      final streamedResponse = await request.send();
      final response = await http.Response.fromStream(streamedResponse);

      if (response.statusCode == 200) {
        final data = jsonDecode(response.body);

        if (data['success'] == true) {
          final docData = data['document'] ?? {};

          setState(() {
            _uploadedDocuments[docType] = {
              'document_type': docType,
              'document_name': docName,
              'document_url': docData['document_url'] ?? docData['url'],
              'public_id': docData['public_id'],
              'filename': file.name,
              'size_bytes': file.size,
            };
          });

          if (mounted) {
            showMessage(context, "✅ $docName uploaded successfully!");
          }
        } else {
          throw Exception(data['message'] ?? 'Upload failed');
        }
      } else {
        final errorData = jsonDecode(response.body);
        throw Exception(errorData['message'] ?? 'Upload failed');
      }
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint("❌ Document upload failed: $e");
      if (mounted) {
        showMessage(
          context,
          "Upload failed: ${e.toString().replaceAll('Exception:', '')}",
          isError: true,
        );
      }
    } finally {
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() {
          _isUploadingDoc = false;
          _uploadingDocType = null;
        });
      }
    }
  }

  MediaType _getMimeType(String fileName) {
    final ext = fileName.toLowerCase().split('.').last;
    switch (ext) {
      case 'pdf':
        return MediaType('application', 'pdf');
      case 'jpg':
      case 'jpeg':
        return MediaType('image', 'jpeg');
      case 'png':
        return MediaType('image', 'png');
      default:
        return MediaType('application', 'octet-stream');
    }
  }

  void _removeDocument(String docType) {
    setState(() {
      _uploadedDocuments.remove(docType);
    });
    if (mounted) {
      showMessage(context, "Document removed");
    }
  }
