  // ============================================================
  // ✅ SUBMIT APPLICATION WITH PAYMENT
  // ============================================================
  Future<void> _submitApplicationWithPayment() async {
    final requiredDocs = widget.scheme.requiredDocuments;

    for (var doc in requiredDocs) {
      if (doc.required && !_uploadedDocuments.containsKey(doc.name)) {
        if (mounted) {
          showMessage(
            context,
            "Please upload: ${doc.name}",
            isError: true,
          );
        }
        _tabController.animateTo(2);
        return;
      }
    }

    final bool? confirmPayment = await _showFeeBreakdownDialog();
    if (confirmPayment != true) {
      debugPrint("❌ User cancelled fee confirmation");
      return;
    }

    if (!mounted) return;

    setState(() {
      _isSubmitting = true;
      _isPaymentProcessing = true;
    });

    try {
      // ============================================================
      // ✅ STEP 2: Build payload
      // ============================================================
      final applicantDetails = {
        'full_name': fullNameCtrl.text.trim(),
        'father_name': fatherNameCtrl.text.trim(),
        'mother_name': motherNameCtrl.text.trim(),
        'date_of_birth': dobCtrl.text.trim(),
        'gender': genderCtrl.text.toLowerCase(),
        'category': categoryCtrl.text,
        'marital_status': maritalStatusCtrl.text,
        'mobile': mobileCtrl.text.trim(),
        'email': emailCtrl.text.trim(),
        'annual_income': int.tryParse(annualIncomeCtrl.text) ?? 0,
        'bpl_status': false,
        'disability_status':
            disabilityStatusCtrl.text.toLowerCase().startsWith('yes'),
        'disability_percentage': 0.0,
        'scheme_name': widget.scheme.schemeName,
        'scheme_id': widget.scheme.schemeId,
        'application_type': 'schemes',
      };

      // ✅ REMOVED: 'address_line2': addressLine2Ctrl.text.trim(),
      final applicantAddress = {
        'address_line1': addressLine1Ctrl.text.trim(),
        'village_city': villageCityCtrl.text.trim(),
        'district': districtCtrl.text.trim(),
        'state': stateCtrl.text.trim(),
        'pincode': pincodeCtrl.text.trim(),
        'country': countryCtrl.text.trim(),
      };

      final documents = _uploadedDocuments.values.map((doc) {
        return {
          'document_type': doc['document_type'],
          'document_name': doc['document_name'],
          'document_url': doc['document_url'],
          'public_id': doc['public_id'],
        };
      }).toList();

      debugPrint("=" * 70);
      debugPrint("📤 SUBMITTING SCHEME APPLICATION WITH PAYMENT");
      debugPrint("   Scheme ID: ${widget.scheme.schemeId}");
      debugPrint("   Scheme Name: ${widget.scheme.schemeName}");
      debugPrint("   Application Fee: ₹$_applicationFee");
      debugPrint("   Service Charge: ₹$_serviceCharge");
      debugPrint("   Subtotal: ₹$_subtotal");
      debugPrint("   GST (18% on ₹$_subtotal): ₹$_gstAmount");
      debugPrint("   TOTAL: ₹$_totalFee");
      debugPrint("=" * 70);

      // ============================================================
      // ✅ STEP 3: Create Razorpay order
      // ============================================================
      final orderResponse = await DioClient.dio.post(
        '/payment/razorpay/create-order',
        data: {
          "amount": _totalFee,
          "application_fee": _applicationFee,
          "service_charge": _serviceCharge,
          "subtotal": _subtotal,
          "gst_amount": _gstAmount,
          "total_amount": _totalFee,
          "use_provided_amount": true,

          "payment_type": "scheme",
          "application_type": "schemes",

          "scheme_id": widget.scheme.schemeId,
          "scheme_name": widget.scheme.schemeName,
          "scheme_name_hindi": widget.scheme.schemeNameHindi,
          "scheme_level": widget.scheme.level,
          "scheme_state": widget.scheme.state,
          "scheme_category": widget.scheme.category,

          "applicant_details": applicantDetails,
          "applicant_address": applicantAddress,
          "documents": documents,

          "user_email": emailCtrl.text.trim(),
          "user_name": fullNameCtrl.text.trim(),
          "user_mobile": mobileCtrl.text.trim(),

          "category_used": "scheme",
        },
      );

      if (!mounted) return;

      if (orderResponse.data['success'] != true) {
        throw Exception(
          orderResponse.data['message'] ?? "Payment initialization failed",
        );
      }

      final String orderId =
          (orderResponse.data['order_id'] ?? '').toString();
      final String paymentId = (orderResponse.data['payment_id'] ??
              orderResponse.data['application_id'] ??
              'temp_${DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch}')
          .toString();

      _razorpayOrderId = orderId;
      _paymentId = paymentId;

      debugPrint("✅ Order created: $orderId");
      debugPrint("   Payment ID: $paymentId");
      debugPrint("   Total amount sent: ₹$_totalFee");
      debugPrint("   payment_type: scheme");
      debugPrint("   application_type: schemes");

      if (orderId.isEmpty) {
        throw Exception("Order ID is missing from response");
      }

      setState(() => _isSubmitting = false);

      // ============================================================
      // ✅ STEP 4: Open PaymentScreen
      // ============================================================
      final paymentResult = await showDialog<Map<String, dynamic>>(
        context: context,
        barrierDismissible: false,
        builder: (dialogContext) => PaymentScreen(
          schemeId: widget.scheme.schemeId,
          schemeName: widget.scheme.schemeName,
          schemeNameHindi: widget.scheme.schemeNameHindi,
          schemeLevel: widget.scheme.level,
          schemeState: widget.scheme.state,
          schemeCategory: widget.scheme.category,
          schemeData: {
            'scheme_id': widget.scheme.schemeId,
            'scheme_name': widget.scheme.schemeName,
            'scheme_name_hindi': widget.scheme.schemeNameHindi,
            'level': widget.scheme.level,
            'state': widget.scheme.state,
            'category': widget.scheme.category,
            'icon': widget.scheme.icon,
            'color': widget.scheme.color,
          },

          serviceId: widget.scheme.schemeId,
          serviceType: 'scheme',
          serviceSubType: widget.scheme.schemeId,
          subServiceName: widget.scheme.schemeName,

          formData: {
            'applicant_details': applicantDetails,
            'applicant_address': applicantAddress,
            'documents': documents,
          },
          userEmail: emailCtrl.text.trim(),
          userName: fullNameCtrl.text.trim(),
          userMobile: mobileCtrl.text.trim(),

          amount: _totalFee,
          categoryUsed: "scheme",
          paymentId: paymentId,
          expiresAt: DateTime.now().add(const Duration(minutes: 15)),
          onPaymentSuccess: () {
            _paymentCompleted = true;
            debugPrint("✅ Payment success callback triggered");
          },
          paymentType: PaymentType.scheme,
        ),
      );

      if (!mounted) return;

      // ============================================================
      // ✅ STEP 5: ONLY after payment success → create application
      // ============================================================
      if (paymentResult != null && paymentResult['success'] == true) {
        debugPrint("=" * 70);
        debugPrint("✅ PAYMENT SUCCESSFUL — NOW CREATING APPLICATION");
        debugPrint("   Razorpay payment id: ${paymentResult['payment_id']}");
        debugPrint("   Payment status returned: ${paymentResult['status']}");
        debugPrint("=" * 70);

        // ✅ Capture the real Razorpay payment ID for the success dialog
        _razorpayPaymentId =
            paymentResult['payment_id']?.toString().isNotEmpty == true
                ? paymentResult['payment_id'].toString()
                : null;

        await _createApplicationAfterPayment(
          applicantDetails: applicantDetails,
          applicantAddress: applicantAddress,
          documents: documents,
          paymentId: paymentId,
          orderId: orderId,
          paymentResult: paymentResult,
        );
      } else {
        debugPrint("❌ Payment cancelled — NO application created");
        if (mounted) {
          showMessage(
            context,
            "Payment cancelled. No application was created.",
            isError: true,
          );
        }
      }
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint("❌ Submit failed: $e");
      if (mounted) {
        showMessage(
          context,
          "Failed to submit: ${e.toString().replaceAll('Exception:', '')}",
          isError: true,
        );
      }
    } finally {
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() {
          _isSubmitting = false;
          _isPaymentProcessing = false;
        });
      }
    }
  }

  // ============================================================
  // ✅ Helper: Detect a MongoDB ObjectId (24-char hex string)
  //    We never want to display these in the success dialog.
  // ============================================================
  bool _isMongoObjectId(String? value) {
    if (value == null) return false;
    final s = value.trim();
    if (s.length != 24) return false;
    return RegExp(r'^[0-9a-fA-F]{24}$').hasMatch(s);
  }

  // ============================================================
  // ✅ Helper: Pick the first non-empty, non-Mongo value
  // ============================================================
  String? _pickHumanReadable(dynamic value) {
    if (value == null) return null;
    final s = value.toString().trim();
    if (s.isEmpty) return null;
    if (s.toLowerCase() == 'null') return null;
    if (s.toLowerCase() == 'undefined') return null;
    if (_isMongoObjectId(s)) return null; // never display Mongo ID
    return s;
  }

  // ============================================================
  // ✅ Resolve the actual Application Number
  // ------------------------------------------------------------
  // Priority order (most-reliable first):
  //   1. top-level `application_number`
  //   2. top-level `application_id` (if non-Mongo)
  //   3. nested `data.application_number`
  //   4. nested `data.application_id` (if non-Mongo)
  //   5. nested `data.application.application_number`
  //   6. nested `data.application.application_id` (if non-Mongo)
  //   7. detail endpoint: `application_number` (top-level)
  //   8. detail endpoint: `application_id` (top-level, non-Mongo)
  //   9. detail endpoint: `application.application_number`
  //  10. detail endpoint: `application.application_id` (non-Mongo)
  //  11. detail endpoint: `data.application_number`
  //  12. detail endpoint: `data.application_id` (non-Mongo)
  //  13. detail endpoint: `data.application.application_number`
  //  14. detail endpoint: `data.application.application_id` (non-Mongo)
  //
  // Returns null if nothing valid found.
  // ============================================================
  Future<String?> _resolveApplicationNumber({
    required Map<String, dynamic> applyResponse,
    required String fallbackApplicationId,
  }) async {
    debugPrint("=" * 70);
    debugPrint("🔎 RESOLVING APPLICATION NUMBER");
    debugPrint("   applyResponse keys: ${applyResponse.keys.toList()}");
    debugPrint("   fallback id: $fallbackApplicationId");
    debugPrint("=" * 70);

    // ---------- Attempt 1: top-level application_number ----------
    final directNumber = _pickHumanReadable(applyResponse['application_number']);
    if (directNumber != null) {
      debugPrint("✅ [1] top-level application_number: $directNumber");
      return directNumber;
    }

    // ---------- Attempt 2: top-level application_id ----------
    final directId = _pickHumanReadable(applyResponse['application_id']);
    if (directId != null) {
      debugPrint("✅ [2] top-level application_id (human-readable): $directId");
      return directId;
    }

    // ---------- Attempt 3: nested data map ----------
    final data = applyResponse['data'];
    if (data is Map) {
      final nestedNumber =
          _pickHumanReadable(data['application_number']);
      if (nestedNumber != null) {
        debugPrint("✅ [3] data.application_number: $nestedNumber");
        return nestedNumber;
      }

      final nestedId = _pickHumanReadable(data['application_id']);
      if (nestedId != null) {
        debugPrint("✅ [4] data.application_id (human-readable): $nestedId");
        return nestedId;
      }

      // ---------- Attempt 5/6: data.application.{number,id} ----------
      final nestedApp = data['application'];
      if (nestedApp is Map) {
        final aNumber =
            _pickHumanReadable(nestedApp['application_number']);
        if (aNumber != null) {
          debugPrint("✅ [5] data.application.application_number: $aNumber");
          return aNumber;
        }
        final aId = _pickHumanReadable(nestedApp['application_id']);
        if (aId != null) {
          debugPrint(
              "✅ [6] data.application.application_id (human-readable): $aId");
          return aId;
        }
      }
    }

    // ============================================================
    // Fallback: hit the detail endpoint
    // ============================================================
    if (fallbackApplicationId.isEmpty) {
      debugPrint("⚠️ No fallback ID to fetch — cannot resolve number");
      return null;
    }

    try {
      debugPrint(
          "🔎 Fetching /schemes/application/$fallbackApplicationId for number...");

      final detailRes = await DioClient.dio.get(
        '/schemes/application/$fallbackApplicationId',
      );

      Map<String, dynamic> body = {};
      if (detailRes.data is Map) {
        body = Map<String, dynamic>.from(detailRes.data as Map);
      }

      debugPrint("   detail body keys: ${body.keys.toList()}");

      // ---------- Attempt 7: body.application_number ----------
      final bodyNumber =
          _pickHumanReadable(body['application_number']);
      if (bodyNumber != null) {
        debugPrint("✅ [7] detail application_number: $bodyNumber");
        return bodyNumber;
      }

      // ---------- Attempt 8: body.application_id (non-Mongo) ----------
      final bodyId = _pickHumanReadable(body['application_id']);
      if (bodyId != null) {
        debugPrint(
            "✅ [8] detail application_id (human-readable): $bodyId");
        return bodyId;
      }

      // ---------- Attempt 9/10: body.application.{number,id} ----------
      final app = body['application'];
      if (app is Map) {
        final aNumber =
            _pickHumanReadable(app['application_number']);
        if (aNumber != null) {
          debugPrint(
              "✅ [9] detail application.application_number: $aNumber");
          return aNumber;
        }
        final aId =
            _pickHumanReadable(app['application_id']);
        if (aId != null) {
          debugPrint(
              "✅ [10] detail application.application_id (human-readable): $aId");
          return aId;
        }
      }

      // ---------- Attempt 11/12: body.data.{number,id} ----------
      final dataMap = body['data'];
      if (dataMap is Map) {
        final dNumber =
            _pickHumanReadable(dataMap['application_number']);
        if (dNumber != null) {
          debugPrint(
              "✅ [11] detail data.application_number: $dNumber");
          return dNumber;
        }
        final dId =
            _pickHumanReadable(dataMap['application_id']);
        if (dId != null) {
          debugPrint(
              "✅ [12] detail data.application_id (human-readable): $dId");
          return dId;
        }

        // ---------- Attempt 13/14: data.application.{number,id} ----------
        final inner = dataMap['application'];
        if (inner is Map) {
          final iNumber =
              _pickHumanReadable(inner['application_number']);
          if (iNumber != null) {
            debugPrint(
                "✅ [13] detail data.application.application_number: $iNumber");
            return iNumber;
          }
          final iId =
              _pickHumanReadable(inner['application_id']);
          if (iId != null) {
            debugPrint(
                "✅ [14] detail data.application.application_id (human-readable): $iId");
            return iId;
          }
        }
      }

      debugPrint(
          "⚠️ Detail fetch succeeded but had no human-readable application number");
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint(
          "⚠️ Could not fetch application detail to resolve number: $e");
    }

    debugPrint("❌ No human-readable application number found anywhere");
    return null;
  }

  // ============================================================
  // ✅ CREATE APPLICATION AFTER PAYMENT SUCCESS
  // ✅ ✅ ✅ CRITICAL FIX (2026-10-15):
  //      - NO MORE `Navigator.pop(context)` after success dialog.
  //      - We call `_resetAfterSuccess()` which ONLY resets local state.
  //      - The parent handles navigation via `widget.onApplicationSubmitted`.
  //      - This prevents the entire route stack (UserDashboard) from being
  //        popped when the apply screen is embedded/inline.
  // ✅ ✅ ✅ NEW FIX (2026-10-16):
  //      - Now calls `_resolveApplicationNumber()` which prefers
  //        `application_number` and falls back to a human-readable
  //        `application_id` — NEVER the Mongo ObjectId.
  // ✅ ✅ ✅ NEW FIX (2026-10-17):
  //      - Success dialog now receives `status: 'payment_verified'`
  //        (or the status returned by the payment flow) so it shows
  //        "PAYMENT VERIFIED" / "PAYMENT SUCCESSFULLY" — exactly like
  //        Job and Service flows.
  //      - `paymentId` passed to the dialog is now the real Razorpay
  //        payment ID (razorpay_payment_id), not our internal payment_id.
  // ============================================================
  Future<void> _createApplicationAfterPayment({
    required Map<String, dynamic> applicantDetails,
    required Map<String, dynamic> applicantAddress,
    required List<Map<String, dynamic>> documents,
    required String paymentId,
    required String orderId,
    required Map<String, dynamic> paymentResult,
  }) async {
    try {
      debugPrint("=" * 70);
      debugPrint("📤 CREATING SCHEME APPLICATION AFTER PAYMENT");
      debugPrint("   Payment ID: $paymentId");
      debugPrint("   Order ID: $orderId");
      debugPrint("=" * 70);

      final payload = {
        'scheme_id': widget.scheme.schemeId,
        'scheme_name': widget.scheme.schemeName,
        'scheme_name_hindi': widget.scheme.schemeNameHindi,
        'scheme_level': widget.scheme.level,
        'scheme_state': widget.scheme.state,
        'scheme_category': widget.scheme.category,
        'applicant_details': applicantDetails,
        'applicant_address': applicantAddress,
        'documents': documents,

        'application_type': 'schemes',
        'payment_type': 'scheme',
        'category_used': 'scheme',

        'payment_id': paymentId,
        'razorpay_payment_id': _razorpayPaymentId,
        'razorpay_order_id': orderId,
        'payment_amount': _totalFee,
        'application_fee': _applicationFee,
        'service_charge': _serviceCharge,
        'gst_amount': _gstAmount,
        'payment_status': 'paid',
        'payment_verified': true,
      };

      debugPrint("📦 Payload prepared:");
      debugPrint("   application_type: ${payload['application_type']}");
      debugPrint("   payment_type: ${payload['payment_type']}");
      debugPrint("   category_used: ${payload['category_used']}");
      debugPrint("   Documents: ${documents.length}");
      debugPrint("   Payment: ₹$_totalFee");

      final response = await DioClient.dio.post(
        '/schemes/apply',
        data: payload,
      );

      debugPrint("📥 Response: ${response.data}");

      if (!mounted) return;

      if (response.data is Map && response.data['success'] == true) {
        final responseMap = Map<String, dynamic>.from(response.data as Map);

        // ============================================================
        // ✅ Extract a fallback ID for the detail-endpoint lookup.
        //    This is used ONLY to fetch the real Application Number,
        //    never displayed.
        // ============================================================
        final rawFallbackId = responseMap['application_id'] ??
            responseMap['_id'] ??
            (responseMap['data'] is Map
                ? (responseMap['data'] as Map)['application_id']
                : null) ??
            (responseMap['data'] is Map
                ? (responseMap['data'] as Map)['_id']
                : null) ??
            '';
        final fallbackIdStr = rawFallbackId.toString();

        debugPrint("🔍 Fallback ID for lookup: '$fallbackIdStr'");

        // ============================================================
        // ✅ Resolve the real Application Number (may return null)
        // ============================================================
        final resolvedNumber = await _resolveApplicationNumber(
          applyResponse: responseMap,
          fallbackApplicationId: fallbackIdStr,
        );

        if (!mounted) return;

        // ============================================================
        // ✅ Decide what to show in the dialog
        //    - If resolved → show that (e.g. "20261000020")
        //    - If not resolved → show "Generating…" (never show Mongo ID)
        // ============================================================
        String displayNumber;
        if (resolvedNumber != null && resolvedNumber.isNotEmpty) {
          displayNumber = resolvedNumber;
        } else {
          displayNumber = 'Generating…';
          debugPrint(
              "⚠️ application_number could not be resolved — using placeholder");
        }

        // ============================================================
        // ✅ NEW (2026-10-17): Payment status shown in the dialog
        // ------------------------------------------------------------
        // Jobs and Services show "PAYMENT VERIFIED" because they pass
        // the status from the PAYMENT VERIFICATION response.
        //
        // We now do the same:
        //   • Prefer paymentResult['status'] (e.g. 'payment_verified')
        //   • Fallback to 'payment_verified'
        // ------------------------------------------------------------
        final paymentStatusString =
            paymentResult['status']?.toString().isNotEmpty == true
                ? paymentResult['status'].toString()
                : 'payment_verified';

        // ============================================================
        // ✅ NEW (2026-10-17): Payment ID shown in the dialog
        // ------------------------------------------------------------
        // Prefer the real Razorpay payment ID (razorpay_payment_id).
        // Fallback to the paymentResult payment id, then our internal ID.
        // ------------------------------------------------------------
        final displayPaymentId =
            _razorpayPaymentId?.isNotEmpty == true
                ? _razorpayPaymentId
                : (paymentResult['payment_id']?.toString().isNotEmpty == true
                    ? paymentResult['payment_id'].toString()
                    : paymentId);

        debugPrint("=" * 70);
        debugPrint("✅ APPLICATION CREATED SUCCESSFULLY");
        debugPrint("   Display Number: $displayNumber");
        debugPrint("   Payment Status (for dialog): $paymentStatusString");
        debugPrint("   Payment ID (for dialog): $displayPaymentId");
        debugPrint("   (fallback id: $fallbackIdStr)");
        debugPrint("=" * 70);

        // ✅ Show the success dialog with the resolved number,
        //    payment status, and payment id.
        // ✅ CRITICAL: onDone callback resets local state ONLY.
        //              We NEVER call Navigator.pop here.
        await ApplicationSuccessDialog.show(
          context,
          applicationNumber: displayNumber,
          title: widget.scheme.schemeName,
          subtitle: widget.scheme.level == 'central'
              ? 'Central Scheme'
              : 'State Scheme',
          paymentType: 'Scheme',
          amountPaid: _totalFee,

          // ✅ NEW: Real Razorpay payment ID
          paymentId: displayPaymentId,

          // ✅ NEW: Payment status → "PAYMENT VERIFIED" / "PAYMENT SUCCESSFUL"
          status: paymentStatusString,

          onDone: () {
            // ✅ FIX: Reset local state — DO NOT touch Navigator.
            _resetAfterSuccess();

            // ✅ FIX: Let the parent decide navigation.
            //         - Inline mode → parent closes inline view (dashboard intact).
            //         - Fullscreen mode → parent calls Navigator.pop.
            widget.onApplicationSubmitted?.call();
          },
        );
      } else {
        throw Exception(
          response.data['message'] ?? 'Application creation failed',
        );
      }
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint("❌ Failed to create application after payment: $e");
      if (mounted) {
        showMessage(
          context,
          "Payment successful but application creation failed. "
          "Please contact support with Payment ID: ${_razorpayPaymentId ?? paymentId}",
          isError: true,
        );
      }
    }
  }

  // ============================================================
  // ✅ FIX: Reset local state after a successful application.
  //         This is safe in BOTH fullscreen and inline/embedded modes.
  //         It NEVER calls Navigator.pop — the parent decides navigation.
  // ============================================================
  void _resetAfterSuccess() {
    if (!mounted) return;

    debugPrint("=" * 70);
    debugPrint("🔄 SchemeApplyScreen: resetting state after success");
    debugPrint("=" * 70);

    setState(() {
      _paymentCompleted = true;
      _isSubmitting = false;
      _isPaymentProcessing = false;
      _uploadedDocuments.clear();
      _razorpayOrderId = null;
      _paymentId = null;
      _razorpayPaymentId = null;
    });

    debugPrint("✅ SchemeApplyScreen: state reset complete (no pop)");
  }

  String _formatFieldName(String field) {
    return field
        .replaceAll('_', ' ')
        .split(' ')
        .map((w) => w.isNotEmpty
            ? '${w[0].toUpperCase()}${w.substring(1)}'
            : '')
        .join(' ');
  }

  // ============================================================
  // TAB 3: DOCUMENTS
  // ============================================================
  Widget _buildDocumentsTab() {
    final requiredDocs = widget.scheme.requiredDocuments;

    return SingleChildScrollView(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
      child: Column(
        children: [
          _buildInfoBanner(
            "Please upload all required documents. Documents marked with * are mandatory.",
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 16),
          _buildSectionCard(
            title: "Required Documents",
            icon: Icons.upload_file,
            children: [
              if (requiredDocs.isEmpty)
                Padding(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.all(20),
                  child: Center(
                    child: Column(
                      children: [
                        Icon(
                          Icons.check_circle,
                          size: 48,
                          color: Colors.green.shade300,
                        ),
                        const SizedBox(height: 12),
                        Text(
                          "No documents required for this scheme",
                          style: TextStyle(
                            fontSize: 14,
                            color: Colors.grey.shade600,
                          ),
                        ),
                      ],
                    ),
                  ),
                )
              else
                ...requiredDocs.map((doc) => _buildDocumentUploadTile(
                      docType: doc.name,
                      docLabel: doc.name,
                      docLabelHindi: doc.nameHindi,
                      isRequired: doc.required,
                    )),
            ],
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 16),
          if (requiredDocs.any((d) => !d.required))
            _buildSectionCard(
              title: "Optional Documents",
              icon: Icons.attach_file,
              children: requiredDocs
                  .where((d) => !d.required)
                  .map((doc) => _buildDocumentUploadTile(
                        docType: doc.name,
                        docLabel: doc.name,
                        docLabelHindi: doc.nameHindi,
                        isRequired: false,
                      ))
                  .toList(),
            ),
          const SizedBox(height: 20),
          _buildFeeCard(),
          const SizedBox(height: 20),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  // ============================================================
  // DOCUMENT UPLOAD TILE
  // ============================================================
  Widget _buildDocumentUploadTile({
    required String docType,
    required String docLabel,
    required String docLabelHindi,
    required bool isRequired,
  }) {
    final isUploaded = _uploadedDocuments.containsKey(docType);
    final isUploading = _isUploadingDoc && _uploadingDocType == docType;
    final docData = _uploadedDocuments[docType];

    return Container(
      margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 12),
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(14),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: isUploaded ? Colors.green.shade50 : Colors.grey.shade50,
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
        border: Border.all(
          color: isUploaded
              ? Colors.green.shade300
              : (isRequired ? Colors.red.shade200 : Colors.grey.shade300),
          width: isUploaded ? 2 : 1,
        ),
      ),
      child: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
        children: [
          Row(
            children: [
              Icon(
                isUploaded
                    ? Icons.check_circle
                    : (isRequired ? Icons.error_outline : Icons.upload_file),
                color: isUploaded
                    ? Colors.green
                    : (isRequired ? Colors.red : Colors.grey),
                size: 24,
              ),
              const SizedBox(width: 12),
              Expanded(
                child: Column(
                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                  children: [
                    Row(
                      children: [
                        Expanded(
                          child: Text(
                            docLabel,
                            style: TextStyle(
                              fontSize: 14,
                              fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                              color: isUploaded
                                  ? Colors.green.shade800
                                  : Colors.black87,
                            ),
                          ),
                        ),
                        if (isRequired)
                          Container(
                            padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                              horizontal: 6,
                              vertical: 2,
                            ),
                            decoration: BoxDecoration(
                              color: Colors.red.shade100,
                              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(4),
                            ),
                            child: Text(
                              "Required",
                              style: TextStyle(
                                fontSize: 9,
                                fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                                color: Colors.red.shade700,
                              ),
                            ),
                          ),
                      ],
                    ),
                    if (docLabelHindi.isNotEmpty)
                      Text(
                        docLabelHindi,
                        style: TextStyle(
                          fontSize: 11,
                          color: Colors.grey.shade600,
                        ),
                      ),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 12),
          if (isUploaded && docData != null)
            Container(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.all(10),
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                color: Colors.white,
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
              ),
              child: Row(
                children: [
                  Icon(
                    Icons.insert_drive_file,
                    color: Colors.green.shade600,
                    size: 20,
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(width: 8),
                  Expanded(
                    child: Column(
                      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                      children: [
                        Text(
                          docData['filename'] ?? 'Document uploaded',
                          style: const TextStyle(
                            fontSize: 12,
                            fontWeight: FontWeight.w500,
                          ),
                          overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                        ),
                        Text(
                          "${((docData['size_bytes'] ?? 0) / 1024).toStringAsFixed(1)} KB",
                          style: TextStyle(
                            fontSize: 10,
                            color: Colors.grey.shade600,
                          ),
                        ),
                      ],
                    ),
                  ),
                  IconButton(
                    onPressed: () => _removeDocument(docType),
                    icon: const Icon(
                      Icons.delete_outline,
                      color: Colors.red,
                      size: 20,
                    ),
                    tooltip: "Remove",
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            )
          else
            SizedBox(
              width: double.infinity,
              child: ElevatedButton.icon(
                onPressed: isUploading
                    ? null
                    : () => _pickAndUploadDocument(docType, docLabel),
                icon: isUploading
                    ? const SizedBox(
                        width: 16,
                        height: 16,
                        child: CircularProgressIndicator(
                          strokeWidth: 2,
                          color: Colors.white,
                        ),
                      )
                    : const Icon(Icons.upload, size: 18),
                label: Text(
                  isUploading ? "Uploading..." : "Upload Document",
                  style: const TextStyle(
                    fontSize: 13,
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                  ),
                ),
                style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(
                  backgroundColor: const Color(0xFF6C63FF),
                  foregroundColor: Colors.white,
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 12),
                  shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10),
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildSectionCard({
    required String title,

          ),

      child: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,

                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10),

  Widget _buildReadOnlyField({
    required String label,
    required String value,
    required IconData icon,
  }) {
    final displayValue = value.isEmpty ? 'Not specified' : value;
    final isMissing = value.isEmpty;

    return Container(
      margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 12),
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: isMissing ? Colors.orange.shade50 : Colors.grey.shade50,
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10),
        border: Border.all(
          color: isMissing ? Colors.orange.shade200 : Colors.grey.shade200,
        ),
      ),
      child: Row(
        children: [
          Icon(
            icon,
            size: 20,
            color: isMissing ? Colors.orange : Colors.grey.shade600,
          ),
          const SizedBox(width: 12),
          Expanded(
            child: Column(
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
              children: [
                Text(
                  label,
                  style: TextStyle(
                    fontSize: 11,
                    color: Colors.grey.shade600,
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w500,
                  ),
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 2),
                Text(
                  displayValue,
                  style: TextStyle(
                    fontSize: 14,
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                    color:
                        isMissing ? Colors.orange.shade800 : Colors.black87,
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
          if (isMissing)
            Icon(
              Icons.warning_amber,
              size: 18,
              color: Colors.orange.shade400,
            ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  // ============================================================
  // BOTTOM BAR — PAY & SUBMIT
  // ============================================================
  Widget _buildBottomBar() {
    return Container(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: Colors.white,
        boxShadow: [
          BoxShadow(
            color: Colors.grey.withOpacity(0.15),
            blurRadius: 10,
            spreadRadius: 2,
            offset: const Offset(0, -2),
          ),
        ],
      ),
      child: SafeArea(
        child: Row(
          children: [
            if (_currentTabIndex > 0)
              Expanded(
                child: OutlinedButton.icon(
                  onPressed: () {
                    _tabController.animateTo(_currentTabIndex - 1);
                  },
                  icon: const Icon(Icons.arrow_back, size: 18),
                  label: const Text("Back"),
                  style: OutlinedButton.styleFrom(
                    foregroundColor: const Color(0xFF6C63FF),
                    side: const BorderSide(color: Color(0xFF6C63FF)),
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 14),
                    shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
                      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            if (_currentTabIndex > 0) const SizedBox(width: 12),

            Expanded(
              flex: _currentTabIndex > 0 ? 1 : 1,
              child: ElevatedButton.icon(
                onPressed: (_isSubmitting || _isPaymentProcessing)
                    ? null
                    : (_currentTabIndex < _tabLabels.length - 1
                        ? () {
                            _tabController.animateTo(_currentTabIndex + 1);
                          }
                        : _submitApplicationWithPayment),
                icon: (_isSubmitting || _isPaymentProcessing)
                    ? const SizedBox(
                        width: 18,
                        height: 18,
                        child: CircularProgressIndicator(
                          strokeWidth: 2,
                          color: Colors.white,
                        ),
                      )
                    : Icon(
                        _currentTabIndex < _tabLabels.length - 1
                            ? Icons.arrow_forward
                            : Icons.payment,
                        size: 18,
                      ),
                label: Text(
                  (_isSubmitting || _isPaymentProcessing)
                      ? "Processing..."
                      : (_currentTabIndex < _tabLabels.length - 1
                          ? "Next"
                          : "Pay ₹$_totalFee & Submit"),
                  style: const TextStyle(
                    fontSize: 14,
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                  ),
                ),
                style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(
                  backgroundColor: _currentTabIndex < _tabLabels.length - 1
                      ? const Color(0xFF6C63FF)
                      : Colors.green,
                  foregroundColor: Colors.white,
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 14),
                  shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

// lib/features/schemes/presentation/screens/scheme_detail_screen.dart
// ============================================================
// SCHEME DETAIL SCREEN — Full details in Hindi
// ✅ FIXED: Added _mapToGovernmentScheme() helper
// ✅ FIXED (2026-10-15): Passes onApplicationSubmitted callback to
//    SchemeApplyScreen so that the parent controls navigation.
//    This prevents logout when the apply screen is embedded/inline.
// ============================================================

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:url_launcher/url_launcher.dart';
import 'package:rojgarnest/core/utils/app_snackbar.dart';
import 'package:rojgarnest/core/master_date/schemes_data.dart';
import 'package:rojgarnest/features/schemes/data/scheme_service.dart';
import 'package:rojgarnest/features/schemes/presentation/screens/scheme_apply_screen.dart';

class SchemeDetailScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  final String schemeId;
  final String schemeName;

  /// ✅ When true, renders WITHOUT Scaffold/AppBar
  final bool isEmbedded;

  /// ✅ Optional back callback (for embedded mode)
  final VoidCallback? onBack;

  /// ✅ Optional apply callback — if provided, called instead of
  /// opening SchemeApplyScreen internally.
  final VoidCallback? onApply;

  /// ✅ When true, the Apply button opens SchemeApplyScreen
  /// INSIDE the current panel (with its own back button)
  final bool openApplyInline;

  /// ✅ Callback invoked when the inline apply screen wants to go back
  final VoidCallback? onApplyBack;

  const SchemeDetailScreen({
    super.key,
    required this.schemeId,
    required this.schemeName,
    this.isEmbedded = false,
    this.onBack,
    this.onApply,
    this.openApplyInline = false,
    this.onApplyBack,
  });

  @override
  State<SchemeDetailScreen> createState() => _SchemeDetailScreenState();
}

class _SchemeDetailScreenState extends State<SchemeDetailScreen>
    with SingleTickerProviderStateMixin {
  // ==================== STATE ====================
  Map<String, dynamic>? _scheme;
  bool _isLoading = true;
  String? _errorMessage;
  bool _isApplying = false;

  /// ✅ When true, we are showing SchemeApplyScreen inline (embedded mode)
  bool _showInlineApply = false;

  late AnimationController _animController;
  late Animation<double> _fadeAnimation;

  // ==================== LIFECYCLE ====================
  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _animController = AnimationController(
      duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 800),
      vsync: this,
    );
    _fadeAnimation = CurvedAnimation(
      parent: _animController,
      curve: Curves.easeOut,
    );
    _loadSchemeDetail();
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _animController.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  // ============================================================
  // ✅ LOAD DATA — backend first, then ALWAYS local fallback
  // ============================================================
  Future<void> _loadSchemeDetail() async {
    setState(() {
      _isLoading = true;
      _errorMessage = null;
    });

    Map<String, dynamic>? schemeData;

    // ---------- STEP 1: Try backend ----------
    try {
      final result = await SchemeService.getSchemeDetail(widget.schemeId);

      if (result['success'] == true && result['scheme'] is Map) {
        schemeData = Map<String, dynamic>.from(result['scheme'] as Map);
        debugPrint("✅ SchemeDetail: loaded from BACKEND");
      } else {
        debugPrint(
            "⚠️ SchemeDetail: backend returned no scheme — trying local");
      }
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint("⚠️ SchemeDetail: backend failed ($e) — trying local");
    }

    // ---------- STEP 2: ALWAYS fall back to local master data ----------
    if (schemeData == null) {
      schemeData = _getMasterDataAsMap();

      if (schemeData != null) {
        debugPrint("✅ SchemeDetail: loaded from LOCAL master data");
      }
    }

    if (!mounted) return;

    // ---------- STEP 3: Commit ----------
    if (schemeData != null && schemeData.isNotEmpty) {
      setState(() {
        _scheme = schemeData;
        _isLoading = false;
        _errorMessage = null;
      });
      _animController.forward();
    } else {
      setState(() {
        _isLoading = false;
        _errorMessage =
            'योजना "${widget.schemeId}" उपलब्ध नहीं है। / Scheme not found.';
      });
    }
  }

  // ============================================================
  // ✅ Convert local GovernmentScheme → full Map
  // ============================================================
  Map<String, dynamic>? _getMasterDataAsMap() {
    try {
      final scheme = SchemesMasterData.getSchemeById(widget.schemeId);
      if (scheme == null) {
        debugPrint("❌ SchemeDetail: master data has no entry for "
            "'${widget.schemeId}'");
        return null;
      }

      return {
        'scheme_id': scheme.schemeId,
        'scheme_name': scheme.schemeName,
        'scheme_name_hindi': scheme.schemeNameHindi,
        'short_description': scheme.shortDescription,
        'short_description_hindi': scheme.shortDescriptionHindi,
        'level': scheme.level,
        'state': scheme.state,
        'category': scheme.category,
        'full_description': scheme.fullDescription,
        'full_description_hindi': scheme.fullDescriptionHindi,
        'icon': scheme.icon,
        'color': scheme.color,
        'is_featured': scheme.isFeatured,
        'tags': scheme.tags,

        // -------- Benefits --------
        'benefits': scheme.benefits
            .map((b) => {
                  'title': b.title,
                  'description': b.description,
                  'amount': b.amount,
                  'type': b.type,
                })
            .toList(),

        // -------- Eligibility --------
        'eligibility': {
          'age_min': scheme.eligibility.ageMin,
          'age_max': scheme.eligibility.ageMax,
          'gender': scheme.eligibility.gender,
          'income_limit': scheme.eligibility.incomeLimit,
          'category': scheme.eligibility.category,
          'education_level': scheme.eligibility.educationLevel,
          'occupation': scheme.eligibility.occupation,
          'domicile_state': scheme.eligibility.domicileState,
          'disability_required': scheme.eligibility.disabilityRequired,
          'bpl_required': scheme.eligibility.bplRequired,
          'aadhaar_required': scheme.eligibility.aadhaarRequired,
        },
        'eligibility_details_hindi': scheme.eligibilityDetailsHindi,

        // -------- Target Beneficiaries --------
        'target_beneficiaries': scheme.targetBeneficiaries,
        'target_beneficiaries_hindi': scheme.targetBeneficiariesHindi,

        // -------- Documents --------
        'required_documents': scheme.requiredDocuments
            .map((d) => {
                  'name': d.name,
                  'name_hindi': d.nameHindi,
                  'required': d.required,
                  'description': d.description,
                })
            .toList(),

        // -------- Steps --------
        'application_steps': scheme.applicationSteps
            .map((st) => {
                  'step_number': st.stepNumber,
                  'title': st.title,
                  'title_hindi': st.titleHindi,
                  'description': st.description,
                  'description_hindi': st.descriptionHindi,
                })
            .toList(),

        // -------- Mode / Contact / Links --------
        'application_mode': scheme.applicationMode,
        'contact_info': {
          'helpline': scheme.contactInfo.helpline,
          'email': scheme.contactInfo.email,
          'website': scheme.contactInfo.website,
          'office_address': scheme.contactInfo.officeAddress,
        },
        'official_website': scheme.officialWebsite,
        'apply_link': scheme.applyLink,

        // -------- Fee --------
        'has_application_fee': scheme.hasApplicationFee,
        'application_fee': scheme.applicationFee,
        'fee_details_hindi': scheme.feeDetailsHindi,

        // -------- Meta --------
        'is_active': true,
        'source': 'local',
      };
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint("❌ SchemeDetail: _getMasterDataAsMap error: $e");
      return null;
    }
  }

  // ============================================================
  // ✅ NEW: Convert Map<String, dynamic> → GovernmentScheme
  // ============================================================
  GovernmentScheme _mapToGovernmentScheme(Map<String, dynamic> map) {
    // ---- Benefits ----
    final benefitsList = <SchemeBenefit>[];
    final rawBenefits = map['benefits'];
    if (rawBenefits is List) {
      for (final b in rawBenefits) {
        if (b is Map) {
          benefitsList.add(SchemeBenefit(
            title: b['title']?.toString() ?? '',
            description: b['description']?.toString() ?? '',
            amount: b['amount']?.toString(),
            type: b['type']?.toString() ?? 'financial',
          ));
        }
      }
    }

    // ---- Eligibility ----
    final rawEligibility = map['eligibility'];
    final eligibilityMap = rawEligibility is Map ? rawEligibility : {};

    final eligibility = SchemeEligibility(
      ageMin: _safeInt(eligibilityMap['age_min']),
      ageMax: _safeInt(eligibilityMap['age_max']),
      gender: eligibilityMap['gender']?.toString(),
      incomeLimit: _safeInt(eligibilityMap['income_limit']),
      category: _safeStringList(eligibilityMap['category']),
      educationLevel: eligibilityMap['education_level']?.toString(),
      occupation: eligibilityMap['occupation']?.toString(),
      domicileState: eligibilityMap['domicile_state']?.toString(),
      disabilityRequired: eligibilityMap['disability_required'] == true,
      bplRequired: eligibilityMap['bpl_required'] == true,
      aadhaarRequired: eligibilityMap['aadhaar_required'] != false,
    );

    // ---- Documents ----
    final documentsList = <SchemeDocument>[];
    final rawDocs = map['required_documents'];
    if (rawDocs is List) {
      for (final d in rawDocs) {
        if (d is Map) {
          documentsList.add(SchemeDocument(
            name: d['name']?.toString() ?? '',
            nameHindi: d['name_hindi']?.toString() ?? '',
            required: d['required'] != false,
            description: d['description']?.toString(),
          ));
        }
      }
    }

    // ---- Steps ----
    final stepsList = <SchemeApplicationStep>[];
    final rawSteps = map['application_steps'];
    if (rawSteps is List) {
      for (final s in rawSteps) {
        if (s is Map) {
          stepsList.add(SchemeApplicationStep(
            stepNumber: _safeInt(s['step_number']) ?? 1,
            title: s['title']?.toString() ?? '',
            titleHindi: s['title_hindi']?.toString() ?? '',
            description: s['description']?.toString() ?? '',
            descriptionHindi: s['description_hindi']?.toString() ?? '',
          ));
        }
      }
    }

    // ---- Contact Info ----
    final rawContact = map['contact_info'];
    final contactMap = rawContact is Map ? rawContact : {};

    final contactInfo = SchemeContactInfo(
      helpline: contactMap['helpline']?.toString(),
      email: contactMap['email']?.toString(),
      website: contactMap['website']?.toString(),
      officeAddress: contactMap['office_address']?.toString(),
    );

    // ---- Target Beneficiaries ----
    final targetBeneficiaries = _safeStringList(map['target_beneficiaries']);
    final targetBeneficiariesHindi =
        _safeStringList(map['target_beneficiaries_hindi']);

    // ---- Tags ----
    final tags = _safeStringList(map['tags']);

    return GovernmentScheme(
      schemeId: map['scheme_id']?.toString() ?? widget.schemeId,
      schemeName: map['scheme_name']?.toString() ?? widget.schemeName,
      schemeNameHindi:
          map['scheme_name_hindi']?.toString() ?? widget.schemeName,
      shortDescription: map['short_description']?.toString() ?? '',
      shortDescriptionHindi:
          map['short_description_hindi']?.toString() ?? '',
      level: map['level']?.toString() ?? 'central',
      state: map['state']?.toString(),
      category: map['category']?.toString() ?? 'other',
      fullDescription: map['full_description']?.toString() ?? '',
      fullDescriptionHindi:
          map['full_description_hindi']?.toString() ?? '',
      benefits: benefitsList,
      eligibility: eligibility,
      eligibilityDetailsHindi:
          map['eligibility_details_hindi']?.toString() ?? '',
      targetBeneficiaries: targetBeneficiaries,
      targetBeneficiariesHindi: targetBeneficiariesHindi,
      requiredDocuments: documentsList,
      applicationSteps: stepsList,
      applicationMode: map['application_mode']?.toString() ?? 'online',
      contactInfo: contactInfo,
      officialWebsite: map['official_website']?.toString(),
      applyLink: map['apply_link']?.toString(),
      hasApplicationFee: map['has_application_fee'] == true,
      applicationFee: _safeInt(map['application_fee']) ?? 0,
      feeDetailsHindi: map['fee_details_hindi']?.toString(),
      icon: map['icon']?.toString() ?? '📋',
      color: map['color']?.toString() ?? 'blue',
      isFeatured: map['is_featured'] == true,
      tags: tags,
    );
  }

  // ✅ Safe int parser (handles int, double, String, null)
  int? _safeInt(dynamic value) {
    if (value == null) return null;
    if (value is int) return value;
    if (value is double) return value.toInt();
    if (value is String) return int.tryParse(value);
    return null;
  }

  // ✅ Safe string-list parser
  List<String> _safeStringList(dynamic value) {
    if (value == null) return [];
    if (value is List) {
      return value.map((e) => e.toString()).toList();
    }
    return [];
  }

  // ============================================================
  // ✅ NAVIGATION
  // ✅ FIXED (2026-10-15): Pass onApplicationSubmitted callback
  //    to SchemeApplyScreen. This callback is invoked AFTER the user
  //    taps "Done" on the success dialog, so the parent controls
  //    navigation without the apply screen ever popping the dashboard.
  // ============================================================
  void _openApplyScreen() {
    if (_scheme == null) return;

    // ✅ If onApply callback provided, use it (embedded mode - parent decides)
    if (widget.onApply != null) {
      widget.onApply!();
      return;
    }

    // ✅ Inline apply mode — show SchemeApplyScreen in the SAME panel
    if (widget.openApplyInline || widget.isEmbedded) {
      setState(() {
        _showInlineApply = true;
      });
      return;
    }

    // ✅ Fallback: full-screen navigation
    Navigator.push(
      context,
      MaterialPageRoute(
        builder: (_) => SchemeApplyScreen(
          scheme: _mapToGovernmentScheme(_scheme!),
          onApplicationSubmitted: () {
            // ✅ FIX: Fullscreen mode — pop back to SchemeDetailScreen.
            //         The dashboard route is untouched (it's deeper in the stack).
            if (mounted) {
              Navigator.of(context).pop();
            }
          },
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  /// ✅ Go back from inline apply screen to scheme detail
  void _closeInlineApply() {
    if (!mounted) return;
    setState(() {
      _showInlineApply = false;
    });
    widget.onApplyBack?.call();
  }

  Future<void> _openUrl(String? url) async {
    if (url == null || url.isEmpty) {
      showMessage(context, 'लिंक उपलब्ध नहीं है', isError: true);
      return;
    }
    try {
      final uri = Uri.parse(url);
      if (await canLaunchUrl(uri)) {
        await launchUrl(uri, mode: LaunchMode.externalApplication);
      } else {
        if (mounted) {
          showMessage(context, 'लिंक नहीं खुल सका', isError: true);
        }
      }
    } catch (e) {
      if (mounted) {
        showMessage(context, 'लिंक खोलने में त्रुटि: $e', isError: true);
      }
    }
  }

  // ==================== BUILD ====================
  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    // ✅ INLINE APPLY MODE — show apply screen in the same panel
    if (_showInlineApply && _scheme != null) {
      return _buildInlineApplyScreen();
    }

    final Widget content = _isLoading
        ? _buildLoadingScreen()
        : _scheme == null
            ? _buildErrorScreen()
            : _buildContent();

    // ✅ EMBEDDED MODE
    if (widget.isEmbedded) {
      return Container(
        decoration: const BoxDecoration(
          gradient: LinearGradient(
            begin: Alignment.topLeft,
            end: Alignment.bottomRight,
            colors: [Color(0xFFF5F7FA), Color(0xFFE8ECF1)],
          ),
        ),
        child: SafeArea(
          child: Column(
            children: [
              _buildEmbeddedHeader(),
              Expanded(child: content),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      );
    }

    // ✅ FULL SCREEN MODE
    return Scaffold(
      backgroundColor: const Color(0xFFF5F7FA),
      body: Container(
        decoration: const BoxDecoration(
          gradient: LinearGradient(
            begin: Alignment.topLeft,
            end: Alignment.bottomRight,
            colors: [Color(0xFFF5F7FA), Color(0xFFE8ECF1)],
          ),
        ),
        child: SafeArea(child: content),
      ),
    );
  }

  // ============================================================

                    spreadRadius: 5,

              child: Row(

                    ),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(width: 12),
                  Expanded(

  // ============================================================
  // EMBEDDED HEADER

  Widget _buildEmbeddedHeader() {

  // ============================================================

  // ============================================================
  // ERROR
  // ============================================================
  Widget _buildErrorScreen() {
    return Center(

  // ============================================================
  // MAIN CONTENT
  // ============================================================
  Widget _buildContent() {
    return FadeTransition(
      opacity: _fadeAnimation,
      child: Column(
        children: [
          if (!widget.isEmbedded) _buildHeader(),
          Expanded(
            child: SingleChildScrollView(
              physics: const BouncingScrollPhysics(),
              padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
              child: Column(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                children: [
                  _buildHeroCard(),
                  const SizedBox(height: 16),
                  _buildFullDescriptionCard(),
                  const SizedBox(height: 16),
                  _buildTargetBeneficiariesCard(),
                  const SizedBox(height: 16),
                  _buildBenefitsCard(),
                  const SizedBox(height: 16),
                  _buildEligibilityCard(),
                  const SizedBox(height: 16),
                  _buildRequiredDocumentsCard(),
                  const SizedBox(height: 16),
                  _buildApplicationStepsCard(),
                  const SizedBox(height: 16),
                  _buildFeeCard(),
                  const SizedBox(height: 16),
                  _buildContactCard(),
                  const SizedBox(height: 100),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          ),
          _buildBottomBar(),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  // ============================================================

  Widget _buildHeader() {
    return Container(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(

          colors: [Color(0xFF6C63FF), Color(0xFFFF6588)],

          bottomLeft: Radius.circular(20),
          bottomRight: Radius.circular(20),
        ),
        boxShadow: [

            blurRadius: 20,
            spreadRadius: 5,
          ),
        ],
      ),

        children: [
          Material(
            color: Colors.white.withOpacity(0.25),
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),

              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
              onTap: widget.onBack ?? () => Navigator.pop(context),

                padding: EdgeInsets.all(8),
                child: Icon(Icons.arrow_back, color: Colors.white, size: 22),
              ),

                  ),

                  widget.schemeName,
                  style: const TextStyle(
                    fontSize: 12,

                ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  // ============================================================
  // HERO CARD
  // ============================================================
  Widget _buildHeroCard() {
    final icon = _scheme!['icon']?.toString() ?? '📋';
    final schemeNameHindi = _scheme!['scheme_name_hindi']?.toString() ??
        _scheme!['scheme_name']?.toString() ??
        '';
    final schemeNameEn = _scheme!['scheme_name']?.toString() ?? '';
    final level = _scheme!['level']?.toString() ?? 'central';
    final state = _scheme!['state']?.toString();
    final isFeatured = _scheme!['is_featured'] == true;

    final levelLabel = level == 'central'
        ? 'केंद्रीय सरकार योजना'
        : 'राज्य सरकार योजना${state != null && state.isNotEmpty ? " • $state" : ""}';

    return Container(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(20),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        gradient: const LinearGradient(
          colors: [Color(0xFF6C63FF), Color(0xFFFF6588)],
          begin: Alignment.topLeft,
          end: Alignment.bottomRight,
        ),
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20),
        boxShadow: [
          BoxShadow(
            color: const Color(0xFF6C63FF).withOpacity(0.3),
            blurRadius: 20,
            spreadRadius: 5,
          ),
        ],
      ),
      child: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
        children: [
          Row(
            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
            children: [
              Container(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.all(14),
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  color: Colors.white.withOpacity(0.25),
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
                ),
                child: Text(
                  icon,
                  style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 34),
                ),
              ),
              const SizedBox(width: 14),
              Expanded(
                child: Column(
                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                  children: [
                    if (isFeatured)
                      Container(
                        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                          horizontal: 8,
                          vertical: 3,
                        ),
                        margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 6),
                        decoration: BoxDecoration(
                          color: Colors.amber.shade100,
                          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10),
                        ),
                        child: const Row(
                          mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                          children: [
                            Icon(Icons.star, size: 12, color: Colors.amber),
                            SizedBox(width: 4),
                            Text(
                              'Featured',
                              style: TextStyle(
                                fontSize: 10,
                                fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                                color: Colors.amber,
                              ),
                            ),
                          ],
                        ),
                      ),
                    Text(
                      schemeNameHindi,
                      style: const TextStyle(
                        fontSize: 20,
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                        color: Colors.white,
                        height: 1.3,
                      ),
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 4),
                    Text(
                      schemeNameEn,
                      style: TextStyle(
                        fontSize: 13,
                        color: Colors.white.withOpacity(0.9),
                      ),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 14),
          Container(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 12, vertical: 6),
            decoration: BoxDecoration(
              color: Colors.white.withOpacity(0.25),
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20),
            ),
            child: Row(
              mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
              children: [
                const Icon(
                  Icons.verified,
                  size: 14,
                  color: Colors.white,
                ),
                const SizedBox(width: 6),
                Text(
                  levelLabel,
                  style: const TextStyle(
                    fontSize: 11,
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                    color: Colors.white,
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  // ============================================================
  // TARGET BENEFICIARIES CARD

  Widget _buildTargetBeneficiariesCard() {

          spacing: 8,
          runSpacing: 8,

            return Container(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                horizontal: 12,

              decoration: BoxDecoration(

              child: Row(

                  const Icon(
                    Icons.check_circle,
                    size: 14,
                    color: Color(0xFF10B981),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(width: 6),
                  Text(
                    b.toString(),
                    style: const TextStyle(
                      fontSize: 12.5,
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                      color: Color(0xFF047857),
                    ),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            );
          }).toList(),
        ),
      ],
    );
  }

                      const SizedBox(height: 8),

                        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(

  // ============================================================
  // ELIGIBILITY CARD
  // ============================================================
  Widget _buildEligibilityCard() {
    final eligibilityDetails =
        _scheme!['eligibility_details_hindi']?.toString() ?? '';
    final eligibility = _scheme!['eligibility'] as Map? ?? {};

    final ageMin = eligibility['age_min'];
    final ageMax = eligibility['age_max'];
    final gender = eligibility['gender'];
    final incomeLimit = eligibility['income_limit'];

    final List<Widget> items = [];

    if (eligibilityDetails.isNotEmpty) {
      items.add(
        Container(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.all(14),
          decoration: BoxDecoration(
            color: const Color(0xFF4F46E5).withOpacity(0.08),
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
            border: Border.all(
              color: const Color(0xFF4F46E5).withOpacity(0.2),
            ),
          ),
          child: Text(
            eligibilityDetails,
            style: const TextStyle(
              fontSize: 13.5,
              height: 1.7,
              color: Color(0xFF1F2937),
            ),
          ),
        ),
      );
    }

    if (ageMin != null || ageMax != null) {
      items.add(_buildEligibilityRow(
        Icons.cake,
        'आयु सीमा',
        'Age Limit',
        '${ageMin ?? 'कोई नहीं'} - ${ageMax ?? 'कोई नहीं'} वर्ष',
      ));
    }

    if (gender != null && gender != 'all') {
      final genderHindi = gender == 'female'
          ? 'महिला'
          : gender == 'male'
              ? 'पुरुष'
              : 'सभी';
      items.add(_buildEligibilityRow(
        Icons.wc,
        'लिंग',
        'Gender',
        genderHindi,
      ));
    }

    if (incomeLimit != null && incomeLimit is num) {
      final incomeLakh = (incomeLimit / 100000).toStringAsFixed(1);
      items.add(_buildEligibilityRow(
        Icons.currency_rupee,
        'आय सीमा',
        'Income Limit',
        '₹$incomeLakh लाख/वर्ष तक',
      ));
    }

    if (items.isEmpty) return const SizedBox();

    return _buildSection(
      title: 'पात्रता',
      titleEn: 'Eligibility',
      icon: Icons.check_circle_outline,
      color: const Color(0xFF4F46E5),
      children: items,
    );
  }

  Widget _buildEligibilityRow(
    IconData icon,
    String labelHindi,
    String labelEn,
    String value,
  ) {
    return Container(
      margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 8),
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: Colors.white,
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10),
        border: Border.all(color: Colors.grey.shade200),
      ),
      child: Row(
        children: [
          Container(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.all(8),
            decoration: BoxDecoration(
              color: const Color(0xFF4F46E5).withOpacity(0.1),
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
            ),
            child: Icon(icon, size: 18, color: const Color(0xFF4F46E5)),
          ),
          const SizedBox(width: 12),
          Expanded(
            child: Column(
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
              children: [
                Text(
                  labelHindi,
                  style: const TextStyle(
                    fontSize: 12,
                    color: Color(0xFF6B7280),
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w500,
                  ),
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 2),
                Text(
                  value,
                  style: const TextStyle(
                    fontSize: 14,
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                    color: Color(0xFF111827),
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  // ============================================================
  // REQUIRED DOCUMENTS CARD
  // ============================================================
  Widget _buildRequiredDocumentsCard() {
    final documents = _scheme!['required_documents'] as List?;
    if (documents == null || documents.isEmpty) return const SizedBox();

    return _buildSection(
      title: 'आवश्यक दस्तावेज',
      titleEn: 'Required Documents',
      icon: Icons.description,
      color: const Color(0xFFEC4899),
      children: [
        ...documents.asMap().entries.map((entry) {
          final doc = entry.value as Map;
          final nameHindi = doc['name_hindi']?.toString() ??
              doc['name']?.toString() ??
              '';
          final nameEn = doc['name']?.toString() ?? '';
          final isRequired = doc['required'] != false;

          return Container(
            margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 8),
            padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
            decoration: BoxDecoration(
              color: Colors.white,
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10),
              border: Border.all(color: Colors.grey.shade200),
            ),
            child: Row(
              children: [
                Container(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.all(8),
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                    color: const Color(0xFFEC4899).withOpacity(0.1),
                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
                  ),
                  child: const Icon(
                    Icons.insert_drive_file,
                    size: 18,
                    color: Color(0xFFEC4899),
                  ),
                ),
                const SizedBox(width: 12),
                Expanded(
                  child: Column(
                    crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                    children: [
                      Text(
                        nameHindi,
                        style: const TextStyle(
                          fontSize: 13.5,
                          fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                          color: Color(0xFF111827),
                        ),
                      ),
                      Text(
                        nameEn,
                        style: const TextStyle(
                          fontSize: 11,
                          color: Color(0xFF6B7280),
                        ),
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                ),
                Container(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                    horizontal: 8,
                    vertical: 3,
                  ),
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                    color: isRequired
                        ? Colors.red.shade50
                        : Colors.grey.shade100,
                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
                  ),
                  child: Text(
                    isRequired ? 'आवश्यक' : 'वैकल्पिक',
                    style: TextStyle(
                      fontSize: 10,
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                      color: isRequired
                          ? Colors.red.shade700
                          : Colors.grey.shade700,
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          );
        }),
      ],
    );
  }

  // ============================================================
  // APPLICATION STEPS CARD
  // ============================================================
  Widget _buildApplicationStepsCard() {

          final stepNum = step['step_number'] ?? (entry.key + 1);
          final titleHindi = step['title_hindi']?.toString() ??
              step['title']?.toString() ??
              '';
          final descHindi = step['description_hindi']?.toString() ??
              step['description']?.toString() ??
              '';

          return Container(
            margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 12),
            child: Row(
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
              children: [
                Column(
                  children: [
                    Container(
                      width: 36,
                      height: 36,

                        gradient: const LinearGradient(
                          colors: [Color(0xFF14B8A6), Color(0xFF2DD4BF)],
                        ),
                        shape: BoxShape.circle,
                        boxShadow: [
                          BoxShadow(
                            color: const Color(0xFF14B8A6).withOpacity(0.3),
                            blurRadius: 8,
                            spreadRadius: 1,
                          ),
                        ],
                      ),
                      child: Center(
                        child: Text(
                          '$stepNum',
                          style: const TextStyle(
                            fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                            color: Colors.white,
                            fontSize: 14,

                        ),
                      ),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
                const SizedBox(width: 12),
                Expanded(
                  child: Container(
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
                    decoration: BoxDecoration(
                      color: Colors.white,
                      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                      border: Border.all(color: Colors.grey.shade200),
                    ),
                    child: Column(
                      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                      children: [
                        Text(
                          titleHindi,
                          style: const TextStyle(
                            fontSize: 14,
                            fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                            color: Color(0xFF111827),
                          ),
                        ),

                        ],
                      ],
                    ),
                  ),

            ),

  }

          ),

      ],
